events.name: elrow Ibiza
events.description:
Prepare for a psychedelic adventure of epic proportions as elrow returns to Saturday nights at [UNVRS] from 6th June - 3rd October 2026.

Reality warps beyond all recognition as you blast off through a technicoloured wormhole and Enter The WORTEX, a gateway to escape the routine and explore a parallel world where madness is the only rule. Following a stratospheric debut last year, the world-class electronic music brand is back with The WOW Factory Presents Enter The WORTEX: six immersive worlds, including two brand-new themes joining Neo Kaos Garden, Delusionville 2.0, Nowmads: New World and Hallucinarium. Each has its own identity and narrative, ensuring that every Saturday night is a new adventure.

The next generation technology of [UNVRS] enables the elrow team to fully realise these new worlds with clarity and scale. Fully immersive environments, kinetic visuals, sculptural works and live performances bring the galaxy of elrow to life like never before. A multi-coloured whirlwind of house, tech house and techno. Explore the three pillars of art, music and performance, and get lost in elrow’s ever-expanding universe every Saturday 6th June - 3rd October 2026.



Lineup elrow Ibiza at [UNVRS] 2026

elrow brings its legendary organised chaos to [UNVRS] for a full season of Saturdays, and the lineup is already delivering. The Opening Night sets the tone with Bastian Bux, Luciano, Manda Moor and Marco Faraone, while the full A-Z promises a summer to remember: Fatboy Slim, Paco Osuna, Hot Since 82, Kölsch, Patrick Topping, Ilario Alicante, Eats Everything, SG Lewis, Joris Voorn and many more still to be announced. Pure elrow energy, world-class sound, and a cast built for the dancefloor.




Tickets for elrow Ibiza at [UNVRS] 2026

Tickets are now on sale starting from 85€ for Entry before 1 am Ticket and 95€ for the Standard tickets. Don't miss out as these sell very fast! For an extra special night out, try a VIP Experience ticket, from 350€ including 5 drinks and premium advantages.

events.name: Carl Cox
events.description:
Carl Cox takes you on a journey through house, techno, and beyond every Sunday night at [UNVRS] from 21st June - 4th October 2026.

The electronic music icon made a huge impact when he returned to the island last summer to continue his storied Ibiza legacy after years away. After just one season, his Sunday night residency has firmly established itself as one of the defining events on the island. With Carl at the helm each and every night, the globally-revered selector has complete creative control to deliver the sounds, emotions, and experiences he believes the dancefloor needs.

Complimented by the exhilarating production capabilities of [UNVRS] and a hand-picked roster of special guests, Carl’s residency is a true pilgrimage for electronic music fans from every corner of the planet. With special all-night long sets for both the residency opening and closing parties, surprise special guests, unannounced B2Bs, and so much, in Carl’s own words: “expect the unexpected, always.”



Lineup Carl Cox at [UNVRS] 2026

The full season lineup has officially landed, and it’s spectacular. Expect heavyweight names and standout dates throughout the summer, including unmissable nights where Carl Cox will join forces with Ritchie Hawtin, David Guetta, or Sasha & John Digweed. Add to that powerhouses like Joseph Capriati, The Martinez Brothers, Chris Stussy, Miss Monique and so many more, and you’ve got a season built for the history books.


Tickets forCarl Cox at [UNVRS] 2026

Tickets for Carl Cox are now on sale. You can choose Entry before Midnight tickets that start at 50€, Entry Before 1am tickets from 75€ or General Admission tickets from 90€. For a more exclusive night out, try a VIP Experience from 300€, including 5 drinks and other premium perks. Don't miss out as these sell very fast!

events.name: Jamie Jones presents Paradise: Starship Eden
events.description:
Jamie Jones and the Paradise crew invite you on board Paradise: Starship Eden as we explore the cosmos together, Wednesday nights at [UNVRS] from 10th June - 7th October.

After a debut season that was one of the most talked about on the island, Jamie Jones returns to showcase his signature expansive house sound in the all-new fully immersive experience. Paradise: Starship Eden is a futuristic ark that travels through impossible skies searching for the rarest beauty the universe could offer. Inside jungles floated in clusters, crystal vines sang, bioluminescent flowers opened and closed to rhythm. This organic behemoth will be fully realised by the incredible production power of [UNVRS] transporting you to Paradise: Starship Eden, an ancient, sentient organism, a cosmic garden, the greatest collection of alien life ever assembled. A world of nature, preserved not in cages, but in harmony.




Lineup Jamie Jones presents Paradise: Starship Eden at [UNVRS] 2026

Jamie Jones returns to [UNVRS] with a standout lineup spanning the Main Room, Wild Comet and Bunker.


The programme brings together leading names like Marco Carola, Loco Dice, The Martinez Brothers, Seth Troxler and Luciano, alongside rising talents such as Max Dean, Fleur Shore and Josh Baker, reflecting the evolution of house and tech house.


B2B sets will be a key highlight this season, with Jamie Jones going back-to-back with artists including Chris Stussy, Joseph Capriati and Marco Carola, plus special pairings like Green Velvet B2B Patrick Topping.

With a Hot Creations takeover and a strong mix of legacy and new talent, Paradise remains one of the island’s most dynamic weekly events.




Tickets Jamie Jones presents Paradise: Starship Eden at [UNVRS] 2026

Tickets for Jamie Jones presents Paradise: Starship Eden are now available from only 75€, for Entry Before 1am tickets, and 85€ for Standard Tickets. If you're looking for a more exclusive experience, VIP Experience tickets are available from 250€, including 4 drinks and other premium perks. Buy them online and save both money and time.

events.name: FISHER
events.description:
FISHERat [UNVRS] 2026

All eyes on the horizon. Something BIG is making waves. It’s FISHER landing at [UNVRS] for year 2 of his Thursday night residency, 4th June - 10th September 2026.

Following a debut season that raised the bar for weekly residencies on the island, the Australian hitmaker returns to cement his Ibiza legacy with 15 high-octane nights of stadium-sized showmanship and relentless energy. FISHER’s mission is clear: to leave audiences breathless with amplified spectacle and surprise, now unmistakable hallmarks of the FISHER experience.

Currently recognised as both the No.1 House DJ and the No.7 DJ in the World in the DJ Mag Top 100 DJs 2025. His track “Atmosphere”, with Kita Alexander, won both an AIR Award and a QMA in 2024. That same year, he was named Solo Artist of the Year at the GQ Men of the Year Awards, Australia.

During each night of his 2025 residency, FISHER stunned the dancefloor by descending over 12 meters from the ceiling to the DJ booth, in 2026 he’s going even bigger.




Lineup FISHER at [UNVRS] 2026

This season's residency brings a seriously stacked lineup. Alongside FISHER’s explosive performances, the lineup features standout artists such as Chris Lake, Chris Lorenzo, Luciano, Noizu, Marco Lys, Maceo Plex, Richy Penny and Paco Osuna, delivering everything from peak‑time house grooves to deeper, more underground sounds. Also joining the roster are acclaimed selectors like Enzo Is Burning, Gorgon City, Jackie Hollander, Little Fritter, Marten Hørger, MPH, Rello, Seth Troxler and Piero Pirupa, rounding out a one‑of‑a‑kind club experience.




Tickets FISHER at [UNVRS] 2026

Tickets for FISHER at [UNVRS] 2026 are on sale now. From only 60 € you can get an Entry before 1am ticket while General admission tickets start at 80€. If you're looking for something a bit more exclusive, try a VIP Experience Ticket for just 300€.

events.name: David Guetta Presents Galactic Circus
events.description:
David Guetta back at [UNVRS] in 2026

The World’s number one DJ, David Guetta returns to Fridays at [UNVRS] from 05 June to 02 October 2026 (with a break on 12 June). Following an explosive debut last year, David Guetta will reclaim his position as the visionary ringmaster at the centre of the alternative utopia known as Galactic Circus. A haven for rebels and renegades from across the galaxy, this carnival of sight and sound sees David Guetta harness the full spectrum of his artistry, delivering sets that span genres, scenes and sounds. Ever-shifting structures hover above, bathing the dancefloor in light, while performers cascade from the ceiling, and the colossal room moves together as one. David Guetta presents Galactic Circus as the destination for those looking to lose themselves in a one-of-a-kind creative vision from electronic music’s most enduring icon.



Lineup David Guetta Presents Galactic Circus 2026

David Guetta brings his Galactic Circus to [UNVRS] with a lineup that means business. MEDUZA, Tchami, James Hype and Layton Giordani lead a roster that also features Alesso, Malaa, Miss Monique, Korolova, Marten Hørger and Mathame, among many others. From peak-time house to melodic and beyond, Galactic Circus is shaping up to be one of the unmissable residencies of the Ibiza 2026 season.


Tickets for David Guetta Presents Galactic Circus 2026

Tickets are now on sale starting from 60€ for a Standard Ticket and 500€ for VIP Experience tickets. Don't miss out as these sell very fast!

events.name: Anyma Presents ÆDEN
events.description:
Anyma Presents ÆDEN at [UNVRS]

Following a fully sold-out debut season, Anyma returns to [UNVRS] on Tuesdays, June - September, with ÆDEN, a new residency concept and a deeply immersive creative experience. The residency at [UNVRS] forms part of the ÆDEN Global Tour 2026, which will take Anyma’s new show to a limited and carefully curated selection of stages worldwide, following his debut as a headliner at Coachella. In Ibiza, however, ÆDEN unfolds as a unique immersive experience, designed to fully utilise the power of the hyperclub, where architecture, technology, sound and audience interact in real time to create a direct and conscious connection with the dancefloor.


Matteo Milleri, the creative force behind Anyma, has established himself as one of the most influential figures in contemporary electronic music. After making history as the first electronic artist to hold a residency at Sphere Las Vegas, and following the international impact of his [UNVRS] residency in 2025, he continues to push the boundaries between music, technology and immersive experience.


His work explores essential themes such as technology, nature, humanity and coexistence, developed across the Genesys album trilogy, Genesys (2023), Genesys II (2024, Afterlife/Interscope) and The End of Genesys, and now evolving into ÆDEN, a new creative phase that deepens these ideas and opens new paths of artistic exploration.



Line up Anyma Presents ÆDEN at [UNVRS] 2026

The lineup for Anyma's residency will be formed by huge artists such as Solomun, Miss Monique, ARTBAT, CamelPhat, Rampa, Amelie Lens, Argy and many more.




Tickets for Anyma Presents ÆDEN in Ibiza 2026

Tickets for Anyma Presents ÆDEN are now on sale. Entry Before 1am tickets are available from 70€, and Standard tickets from 80€. If you're looking for a more premium experience, VIP Experience tickets are available for 500€, including 5 drinks.

No Art Ibiza at [UNVRS] in 2026

Internationally revered event series and independent record label, No Art, returns to take over [UNVRS] for two special events on 24 May and 29 September. They showcased their expert curation and high-concept production at their one-off event last year at [UNVRS], and we’ve invited them back for two nights across the summer. More than just a club night, No Art hosts unconventional art performances and pioneering musicians at unique locations, pushing the boundaries of nightlife and of electronic music.

Come and experience a fusion of cutting-edge electronic music, elevated, artistic design, and the expressive energy that defines their international community. Nights rooted in culture, crafted with care, and built for those who seek more than just a dancefloor.

events.name: [UNVRS] Closing Party
events.description:
[UNVRS] CLOSING PARTY

The countdown to the Closing is on. Mission 2026 will come to its explosive conclusion on Saturday 10th October.

The world’s first hyperclub will close out season 02 with one last unforgettable dancefloor journey. The night will feature one-off visual production, taking you into a new world of electronic music with immersive visuals and heavyweight sound. Expect colossal sets from some of our favourite artists from across the globe, unexpected team-ups and a night that will live long in Ibiza history.

In the Main Room we have assembled some of the most powerful names in contemporary house music, including Adriatique, Dennis Cruz, East End Dubs, Mochakk, Rafael, The Martinez Brothers, WhoMadeWho and a very special guest.

The Wild Comet will set the tone with performances from Bender, Dennis Quinn, DJ Mag All Stars, Kamma, Mella Dee and Mr Belt & Wezol, while the Bunker will host Discoliscious and Melon Bomb.

This is your last night to experience the #1 Club in the World this year. When the music stops, this chapter comes to an end. Don’t miss your chance to be a part of it.

The 2026 season comes to an end with an unmissable series of Closing Parties at the world’s first hyperclub. This will be the only place to see some of the biggest artists on the planet in Ibiza for the final time this year. No matter what vibe you’re looking for, we’ve got you covered.


Tickets for [UNVRS] Closing party 2026

Tickets are available now for [UNVRS] Closing Party from 90€ for 'Entry before 1am tickets' and 100€ for 'Standard Ticket'.

events.name: Tiësto

Tiësto at [UNVRS] 2026

A true pioneer of electronic music, Tiësto has consistently redefined, reshaped, and reignited the scene, birthing new genres along the way. Don’t miss Tiësto, Mondays at [UNVRS]. 03 - 31 August 2026.

events.name: Black Coffee
events.description:
Black Coffee plays in Ibiza at [UNVRS] on 27 May, 22 September and 01 October 2026.

Two titans united in sound: Black Coffee and [UNVRS]. One of the most important names in contemporary electronic music is coming to the world’s first hyperclub. Three highly anticipated shows from an artist like no other.

The South African pioneer, Black Coffee, blends traditional African percussion with distinctively metropolitan techno, a sound dubbed “Afropolitan House”. He has over 20 years in the game and over the last decade has become an Ibiza institution, holding an acclaimed Saturday night residency at Hï Ibiza since 2017 and helping to popularise his sound across the island and beyond.

The GRAMMY-winning artist has collaborated with Alicia Keys, Drake, Pharrell Williams, Diplo, Usher and [UNVRS] resident DJ David Guetta, and is one of the top touring performers in the world. After a spellbinding set at the [UNVRS] Closing Party last year, Black Coffee returns to take control of the hyperclub on Wednesday 27 May, Tuesday 22 September and Thursday 01 October.



Lineup Black Coffee at [UNVRS] 2026

The lineup of guests joining Black Coffee at [UNVRS] will be announced soon!

venues.description:
[UNVRS] Information

[UNVRS] (pronounced "Universe") is the world's first hyperclub, opened in 2025 and located in San Rafael, Ibiza. A new category of nightlife experience built for the next generation of club culture, it is the official DJ Mag #1 Club in the World 2026 - making history as the first venue to top the poll in its debut year. Weekly 2026 DJ residencies include Anyma Presents ÆDEN, Armin van Buuren Presents A State Of Trance (ASOT), Carl Cox, David Guetta Presents Galactic Circus, elrow, FISHER, Jamie Jones Presents Paradise, John Summit Presents Experts Only and Tiësto. The venue features three interconnected rooms with arena-scale production and festival-level sound, light and visual systems. Each night is a unique production created exclusively for [UNVRS], combining the scale of an arena with the high-end service of a luxury nightclub. Founded by Yann Pissenem, Owner, Founder & CEO of The Night League and Ushuaïa Entertainment, Ushuaïa Ibiza and Hï Ibiza, [UNVRS] runs from May - October each year. [UNVRS] defines a new standard for nightlife.

Bathed in sunshine and sea breezes, the magic of the oceans comes alive like a wave washing over the crowd.

The influential Scandinavian trio is made up of DJ producers Axwell, Steve Angello and Sebastian Ingrosso, each one an acclaimed artist in their own right. After joining forces in 2008 they delivered an unparalleled run of hits, including, “One” featuring Pharrell and “Save The World”, and “Don’t You Worry Child”, topping charts, radio play and clubs and festivals around the world. As a group, the Swedes have been in DJ Mag’s Top 100 DJs every year since 2010, including making it into the coveted Top 10.


After a hiatus in 2013, they came back together in 2018 with a string of stadium-sized anthems, such as “Ray of Solar” and “See The Light”, and “Turn On The Lights again” with Fred Again.. Their highly anticipated debut album, Paradise Again was released in 2022 and showcased their artistry and forward-thinking ethos.


The pairing of Swedish House Mafia’s supersized sounds and Ushuaïa Ibiza’s breathtaking production levels will ensure these events will be a highlight of the summer for dance music fans from across the globe.

venues.description:
Ushuaïa Ibiza information

Ushuaïa Ibiza has been the destination of choice for international thrill-seekers arriving on the island since opening in 2011. Hosting the biggest superstar DJs in the world, Ushuaïa Ibiza's iconic stage, large pool area, and open-air dancefloor guarantee an unmatched musical experience pairing incredible production with immersive performances to create truly unforgettable moments.


The first entirely open-air venue, Ushuaïa Ibiza changed the clubbing landscape on the island. With a focus on daytime parties starting in the afternoon, it’s a genuinely life-changing experience listening to your favourite artists, while the sun sets and planes are swooping down over the Ushuaïa Ibiza stage as they land at Ibiza airport.


Dedicated to providing the best outdoor entertainment possible, each summer the venue features an impeccable lineup of superstar resident DJs and the world’s leading club brands from across the electronic music spectrum including David Guetta, Martin Garrix, Calvin Harris, Tomorrowland, ANTSand many more.


The dancefloor stretches from the stage to the pool, with a luxurious VIP area to the right. Towards the back, you’ll find The Cloud, a raised terrace with breathtaking views of the show.


A gateway to a hedonistic wonderland where guests can escape the ordinary and immerse themselves in residencies and guest appearances from the very best in global talent. The venue transports guests to a world beyond imagination, a dance music utopia, where lifelong memories are made.

events.name: Black Coffee
events.description:
Black Coffee plays at Hï Ibiza every Saturday in the Theatre, while Skepta brings Más Tiempo to the Club Room


THEATRE - Black Coffee


The artist behind one of the most influential sounds of our time returns for an 8th year of his flagship Saturday night residency at Hï Ibiza, renewing a partnership that has become a symbol of the island for its influence on contemporary electronic music.


A singular figure in electronic music, Black Coffee’s blend of African roots, Afropolitan sensibility and decades-honed musical intuition positioned him as a pioneer of Afro House long before it entered global consciousness. He became the first African artist to win the GRAMMY for Best Dance/Electronic Album for Subconsciously, a milestone that solidified his role as a global ambassador for African sounds.

The relationship between Black Coffee and Hï Ibiza began in 2017, the club’s inaugural year. Founded on a visionary belief that Ibiza was ready for a new sound, embodied by a new headline resident DJ and tastemaker. This collaboration has grown to become one of the island’s defining residencies: sophisticated, emotional and deeply connected to the dancefloor, embraced by an international audience that understands music as a transformative journey.

Each season Black Coffee invites artists, filmmakers and creative talents from across the African art scene to shape the visual universe of the residency.




CLUB ROOM - Skepta Presents Más Tiempo


Grime pioneer Skepta brings his house-focused label and event brand Más Tiempo to Hï Ibiza with a new Saturday night residency in the Club Room. For over two decades, Skepta has reshaped the global reach of British music. A rapper, producer, creative director and cultural entrepreneur, his career has been instrumental in taking grime from London’s pirate radio underground to the centre of global music culture. He founded the influential collective Boy Better Know and won the coveted Mercury Prize.


In recent years Skepta has expanded his artistic language into electronic music and club culture. Conceived as a creative platform to explore new textures within contemporary house music, Más Tiempo embodies a different aspect of Skepta’s sonic universe: warm grooves, uplifting energy and a vision deeply rooted in the collective experience of the club.




Lineup Black Coffee at Hï Ibiza 2026

Black Coffee brings an extraordinary cast of guests to his residency: Dixon, Damian Lazarus, Guy Gerber, Kabza De Small, Kerri Chandler, Loco Dice and CamelPhat headline a list that also features ANOTR, Dubfire, Henrik Schwarz, Marco Carola, WhoMadeWho and many more. From deep Afro house to raw techno, every Saturday is a different journey, and the full A-Z guarantees there is something for everyone.




Tickets for Black Coffee at Hï Ibiza 2026

Tickets for Black Coffee are now on sale starting from 80€ for Entry Before 1am tickets, or 100€ for General Admission tickets. If you're looking for a Premium experience, VIP tickets ara available for 1000€. Don't miss out as these sell very fast!

events.name: Hï Ibiza Closing Party
events.description:
Hï Ibiza Closing Party 2026

One more time, together.

The 2026 season will go down in history as one of the most transformational summers on the island. This year, Hï Ibiza connected cultures from every corner of the globe through pioneering residencies by the international scene’s greatest talents. ​

The crescendo to this unforgettable summer comes on Friday 9th October, when Hï Ibiza will open its doors for one final time this year. Join us on the dancefloor for one last night of exceptional electronic music from artists who embody the multi-genre, multicultural ethos of the four-time #1 club in the world. ​

The Theatre will host an extra-long exploration of Afro house, house, Latin house, and beyond, featuring Adam Ten & Mita Gami, Black Coffee, Delilah, Maz & Antdot, Paco Osuna, and The Martinez Brothers. ​

In The Club Room, the Más Tiempo crew return for one last takeover this summer. Djammin, Meeshy, Ossie, Skepta and The Menendez Brothers will keep the vibes sky-high from start to finish. ​

Take a trip into the Wild Corner for high-energy selections from Candidate, Edd, Melon Bomb, MiNNA and Saigon. ​

This is one more night of losing yourself in the dance, one more night of shared dancefloor moments, one more night of the connection, freedom and energy that only Ibiza can create. ​

Secure your spot on the dancefloor, get your tickets and VIP tables now.

Tickets for Hï Ibiza Closing Party 2026

Tickets are available now for the Hï Ibiza Closing Party from 85€ for 'Entry before 1am' and 100€ for 'Standard Ticket'.

events.name: MEDUZA & James Hype Present Our House
events.description:
MEDUZA & James Hype Present Our House every Wednesday at Hï Ibiza supported by OFFWEEK at Club Room

THEATRE - MEDUZA & James Hype present OUR HOUSE


MEDUZA & James Hype Present OUR HOUSE at Hï Ibiza on Wednesday 27th May - 30th September 2026. Highly acclaimed DJs and producers, MEDUZA and James Hype, return to the world’s number one club for their fourth season as Hï Ibiza residents. Now moving to midweek their OUR HOUSE residency will take over the Theatre every Wednesday from 27th May to 30th September.Built on a foundation of authentic musical experience, OUR HOUSE will explore the full spectrum of house music, bridging the gap between underground intensity and main-stage energy.

Italian trio MEDUZA will deliver their electrifying hybrid live concept, MEDUZA³ each week. Blending the art of DJing with live piano, cutting-edge MIDI controls, and dynamic performance elements, this innovative show offers an entirely fresh approach to experiencing electronic music. Luca de Gregorio, Mattia Vitale and Simone Giani perform together, seamlessly fusing live and digital instrumentation. The most streamed Italian artists of all time, MEDUZA, have conquered global charts with their emotionally-charged anthems, including “Lose Control”, “Piece Of Your Heart” and “Bad Memories”.


UK tastemaker James Hype will return with his trailblazing SYNC concept, upgraded for 2026. This unique show fuses innovative technology with James Hype’s high-octane mixing style to visualise his signature DJ tricks, via a custom lighting array that flawlessly synchronises with his actions on the decks. It transforms and enhances the dynamic audio-visual experience, creating an unparalleled and high-energy atmosphere, perfectly suited to the relentless performance style of James Hype. As a producer, he has over 10 million monthly listeners on Spotify and two UK Top 10 hits in “More Than Friends” and “Ferrari”. Don’t miss MEDUZA & James Hype Present OUR HOUSE. Wednesdays at Hï Ibiza 27th May - 30th September 2026.



CLUB ROOM - OFFWEEK (27/05/26 - 29/07/26)


For the first time in its history, OFFWEEK leaves Barcelona to deliver a debut Ibiza residency at the world’s #1 club. The cutting-edge curation that has made OFFWEEK one of the global destinations for electronic music will be in full effect across 10 unmissable nights. This exclusive residency, which celebrates the 10th year of OFFWEEK, will showcase the most exciting artists and tastemakers from across house, techno and beyond.




CLUB ROOM - Jonas Blue Presents SENSES (05/08/26 - 30/09/26)


Jonas Blue’s new concept, SENSES, blends melodic electronic music, global influences and an immersive experience tailored for the Club Room. Inspired by pioneering spaces such as teamLab in Japan and the Las Vegas Sphere, this new multi-sensory experience blends music, visuals, atmosphere and the senses to create a fully immersive environment that showcases the artistic evolution of Jonas Blue. Since emerging as a global force in electronic music, Jonas Blue has built a catalogue surpassing 22 billion streams, establishing himself as one of the world’s leading dance artists. In 2026, Jonas enters a new creative phase, led by the release of “Edge Of Desire”, a record that signals confidence, evolution, and renewed focus. With a club-focused music policy and a night that champions the closeness between artist and audience, this special 9-night run will be one of the highlights of the 2026 season.


Don’t miss Jonas Blue Presents SENSES, Wednesdays, 5 August to 30 September 2026, in the Hï Ibiza Club Room.




Lineup MEDUZA & James Hype Present Our House 2026

Meduza and James Hype headline the season at the Theatre, joined by an exceptional roster that spans the full spectrum of house and electronic music: Anna Tur, The Blessed Madonna, Eli & Fur, Korolova, Magdalena, Maya Jane Coles, Nora En Pure, Pauza, Sam Divine, TSHA and many more.

And the energy doesn't stop there. from May 27 to July 29, the Club Room turns up the heat as OFFWEEK takes over with a stellar lineup featuring Zamna Sound System, Benny Benassi,Agents Of Time, Recondite, Helena Hauff, Alok and many more.

events.name: MESTIZA
events.description:
Sundays at Hï Ibiza bring MESTIZA to the Theatre, while Indira Paganotto presents ARTCORE in the Club Room

THEATRE - MESTIZA


In a historic moment for electronic music, MESTIZA take control of the Hï Ibiza Theatre for an 11-date residency, becoming the first female artists to lead a summer residency at the world’s number one club. The Spanish duo are known for an artistic vision that fuses tradition and electronic avant-garde, combining flamenco roots with high-impact contemporary production and a deeply emotional dancefloor narrative.

Last year, the duo delivered a highly impactful residency during the opening stretch of the season, alongside standout performances at Ushuaïa Ibiza and [UNVRS]. This year, they return with a full-season residency that cements their legacy on the island.

Since their formation in 2021, MESTIZA have developed a distinctive sonic identity that builds a bridge between the ancestral and the futuristic, where house, melodic techno and Latin grooves intertwine with Spanish percussion and the emotional intensity of flamenco. Their debut album, “Quëreles”, debuted at number one in Spain in its first week, and their second studio album, “Spanish Chica”, is due to drop in April 2026. That same month, they will make history again as the only female Spanish artists to perform at Coachella.

MESTIZA's vision connects cultural heritage with the cutting edge of global electronic music, which aligns naturally with Hï Ibiza’s ethos of Connecting Cultures. Don’t miss their residency 31st May - 5th July and from 6th September - 4th October 2026.



CLUB ROOM - Indira Paganotto Presents ARTCORE


After an explosive debut residency in 2025, Indira Paganotto moves to Sunday nights with a residency that will shine a spotlight on her label ARTCORE, and on the psy-techno movement she has helped shape and define on a global scale.

One of the island’s most influential artists and a key figure on the international scene, Paganotto began 2026 with a huge milestone, working together with Beatport to launch the psy-techno category on the platform. This work is a testament to her dedication to the genre and her relentless promotion of the sound into a global force.

Founded in 2023, ARTCORE is one of the creative driving forces of the psy-techno movement, with over 15 releases shaping a distinctive sonic and conceptual aesthetic. In 2025, the label reached a new level with curated stages at some of the world’s biggest festivals, reaffirming its role as a platform for innovation, authenticity and artistic development.



Lineup for MESTIZA and Indira Paganotto at Hï Ibiza 2026

MESTIZA return with a carefully curated roster. MoBlack, Jan Blomqvist, Patrick Mason, Joezi, Nooriyah lead a lineup that spans the full spectrum of the Mestiza sound, joined by Apache, Dan Tanev, Drush, Faul & Wad, Marten Lou, Pole Position, and many more.


Meanwhile, Indira Paganotto headlines a season that brings some of the most respected names in techno and underground electronic music to the Club Room. Ben Klock, Alignment, Anfisa Letyago, KINK (Live), Sam Paganini and Valentinø lead a carefully assembled roster, joined throughout the season by a host of headliners, residents and supporters.




Tickets for MESTIZA and Indira Paganotto at Hï Ibiza 2026

Tickets for MESTIZA and Indira Paganotto at Hï Ibiza 2026 are now on sale! Choose an Entry Before Midnight ticket from 30€, an Entry Before 1am ticket from just 40€ or a Standard ticket from 50€. For an extra special experience, grab a VIP Stage ticket for just 150€, including 3 drinks and exclusive VIP perks!

events.description:
HUGEL and Miss Monique return to Hï Ibiza, on Thursdays from the 4th June to the 24th September 2026.

THEATRE - HUGEL Presents Make The Girls Dance


Latin house instigator HUGEL returns with his Make The Girls Dance residency, bringing the most infectious, relentless party energy to the Theatre. After an incendiary debut last year, the producer behind “I Adore You”, “Loosen Up”, “Jamaican (Bam Bam)” and more will be serving up nonstop Latin rhythms, alongside a curated crew of groove-obsessed selectors.


Hailing from the multicultural port city of Marseille, France, HUGEL embraces the rhythms he grew up around. Influences from classic Latin house and Afro house, as well as other hypnotic global sounds, can be heard in his productions and he brings it all together in his spectacular DJ sets.


In 2025, HUGEL lit up the Theatre every week and summoned Latin house devotees and passionate dancers to party with him all night long. As an artist who is fast becoming an Ibiza favourite, he even DJed in a local supermarket on the island making for a one-of-a-kind livestream. Catch HUGEL’s Make The Girls Dance in full flight every Thursday from 4th June - 24th September 2026.



CLUB ROOM - Miss Monique


The Ukrainian progressive house sensation has been on an unstoppable rise through the electronic music scene in recent years. She’s building a momentum that can’t be ignored, releasing heaters like “Nomacita” and “Concorde”, heading up Siona Records, and playing clubs and festivals all over the world alongside the likes of David Guetta and Solomun.


Her Club Room takeovers in 2025 cemented her as part of Hï Ibiza’s heavyweight crew. Bathed in green light, Miss Monique shaped the residency with her signature blend of progressive house, melodic techno, and deep, club-ready rhythms. In 2026, Miss Monique returns to guide you into her world every Thursday, with the help of her favourite DJs from the Siona roster and beyond.




Lineup for HUGEL and Miss Monique at Hï Ibiza 2026

Get ready for an epic roster every Thursday, as HUGEL brings a killer cast of Latin house, Afro house and groove‑driven artists, with names like AMÉMÉ, Da Capo, HVMZA, Melé, MoBlack and THEMBA joining him throughout the season.



Tickets for HUGEL and Miss Monique at Hï Ibiza 2026

Tickets for HUGEL and Miss Monique at Hï Ibiza are on sale now. You can purchase and Entry Before Midnight ticket from just 40€, an Entry Before 1am ticket from 50€ or a Standard ticket from 60€. If you're looking for a more exclusive night out, don't miss our VIP Experience tickets, for 500€, including 5 drinks and VIP perks. This is a very demanded event and likely to sell out, don't miss it!

events.name: Francis Mercier presents Solèy
events.description:
Francis Mercier brings Solèy to Hï Ibiza's Theatre every Monday, with Andrea Oliva presenting All I Need in the Club Room

THEATRE - Francis Mercier presents Soléy


The Haitian DJ and producer shapes a sonic ritual that transforms Mondays into an evocative realm where the sounds of the Levant, Africa, and the Caribbean collide.

A musical powerhouse, Francis Mercier, prioritises artistic identity, cultural roots, and emotion over fleeting trends. His globally renowned hits, including “Sauti”, “Premier Gaou (Nitefreak Remix)”, and “Kamili”, as well as his entire discography, have collectively surpassed over 500 million streams. Each release embodies the same philosophy: music deployed to reach all cultures and corners of the world.

​Solèy, which means “sun” in Haitian Creole, is a global community that Mercier has taken to Paris, London, Mumbai, LA, Ibiza, Tulum, and even the Giza Pyramids in Egypt. It’s a movement that connects cultures through joy and movement. This debut residency at Hï Ibiza will see Solèy come to life in the world’s #1 club.

Each week, Mercier will guide the dancefloor on a multicultural journey across cultures, sounds, and generations, expertly blending African and Caribbean roots with Arabic, Latin, and European influences into a vibrant, energetic, and organic house language.

The Solèy experience goes beyond DJ sets, with live guitar, djembe, and choreographed dance performances woven into each event. These add new layers of cultural and artistic expression to the residency.

CLUB ROOM - Andrea Oliva presents All I Need
A certified Ibiza institution, Andrea Oliva is a respected tastemaker known for his masterful command of the dancefloor. His signature sound unties deep rhythms with emotionally resonant anthems for an experience that puts the music first.

All I Need is his label, event and apparel brand that embodies Oliva’s fearless self expression at clubs and festivals across the globe. This moment carries special meaning, as the Club Room at Hï Ibiza was where Andrea held his first Ibiza residency, during the venue’s opening year. Returning now with All I Need represents a full circle moment, this time not only as an artist, but at the helm of a globally established brand with its own identity, community, and clearly defined creative vision.

The residency at Hï Ibiza reflects this evolution. Every Monday, the Club Room will host carefully curated lineups combining exciting emerging talents with established international headliners, all aligned with the musical direction and spirit of the brand, bringing an irresistible vibe to the Club Room on Monday nights.



Lineup Francis Mercier presents Solèy Hï Ibiza 2026

The residency is powered by a carefully curated lineup of global heavyweights and rising talent. Standout names include Diplo, Kölsch, Henrik Schwarz, Jan Blomqvist, LP Giobbi, Sébastien Léger, Satori and Raxon, alongside Afro house leaders such as THEMBA, Shimza, Da Capo, Enoo Napa, Kitty Amor and MoBlack.


It also features iconic collaborations and special B2B moments, with artists like ANANÉ & Louie Vega, Major League DJz, Sparrow, Afrojack, Mahmut Orhan, Kasango and Notre Dame, delivering a diverse and forward-thinking musical journey throughout the season.




Tickets for Francis Mercier presents Solèy at Hï Ibiza 2026

Tickets for Francis Mercier presents Solèy are now on sale starting at only 30€ for an Entry Before Midnight ticket, 40€ for an Entry before 1 am ticket and 50€ for the Standard tickets. Don't miss out as these sell very fast!

events.name: Eastenderz
events.description:
East End Dubs’ Eastenderz and Paco Osuna’s NOW HERE take over Tuesdays at Hï Ibiza, marking Eastenderz’s debut season alongside the return of NOW HERE for its fifth year in the Club Room


THEATRE - Eastenderz


In Ibiza, the energy never stops. It transfers, connects, amplifies, and stays with you long after you’ve left the island. In 2026, Eastenderz will harness that same energy for their new residency at Hï Ibiza.


This debut Eastenderz residency will serve as an active power source, with energy transferred from DJ to dancefloor and back again. Leading the project is East End Dubs, the London-based DJ, producer, and creative force behind Eastenderz, who presents a residency where music comes first. With a sonic identity that moves primarily through deep tech and minimal house, infused with dub, garage, and groove, embodies by tracks like Eastenderz brings a soundtrack precision-engineered for the dancefloor.


Experience the raw energy of Eastenderz, every Tuesday from 2 June to 6 October.




CLUB ROOM - Paco Osuna presents NOW HERE


His longest season to date will see Osuna deliver a residency built on the foundations of presence, musical openness and a deep connection with the dancefloor. NOW HERE celebrates that precise moment when everything aligns: sound, body, light and emotion. For Paco Osuna, Ibiza was never just another destination. When he first set foot on the island in the late 1990s, it marked a vital and creative revelation. “Ibiza changed my outlook on life and opened my mind,” he has stated.


Each week, Paco Osuna will take the reins of the Club Room, delivering his signature hybrid live/DJ sets that showcase his boundless creativity and impeccable music taste. Osuna approaches the booth not to prove anything, but to share: music, energy, learning and evolution with a dancefloor that responds when it feels something real is happening. Throughout the season, Paco Osuna will be joined by a carefully curated selection of emerging artists and established figures from across the global scene, for a music programme that does not chase trends or anchor itself in the past, but is built firmly in the present.



Lineup Eastenderz at Hï Ibiza 2026

The weekly lineup for Eastenderz has been anounced and big names will be joining East End Dubs in the Theatre: Marco Carola, Hot Since 82, Ewan McVicar, Mason Collective, etc.


Meanwhile, in the Club Room, Paco Osuna brings underground icons and cutting-edge selectors, including Franky Rizardo, Nicole Moudaber, Iglesias, Melanie Ribbe, Rafa Barrios, Luuk van Dijk, Joëlla Jackson and Manuel Torcello.



Tickets for Eastenderz at Hï Ibiza 2026

Tickets for Eastenderz are now on sale starting from 30€ for Entry Before Midnight tickets, 40€ for Entry before 1 am tickets and 50€ for the Standard tickets. For an even more special night out, try a VIP Experience ticket for just 150€, including 3 drinks and other premium perks. Don't miss out as tickets sell very fast!

events.name: CamelPhat
events.description:
CamelPhat Present Summer of Love at the Theatre of Hï Ibiza on Fridays, while Ewan McVicar Presents Club Knuckles in the Club Room

THEATRE - CamelPhat Present Summer of Love


The UK duo are one of the most in-demand names in house music, with world-conquering productions spanning melodic, tech and deep. CamelPhat return to the island with Summer of Love, a celebration of human connection and the energy that lives between people on the dancefloor. It’s not about genres or moments, but what happens when the music takes hold, losing yourself in the dance and finding each other in the process. A night built for remembering why we come to Ibiza in the first place.

Immerse yourself in their back catalogue, which spans certified anthems, including “Breathe”, “Panic Room” and “The Sign”. GRAMMY-nominated and multi-platinum certified, CamelPhat have headlined some of the most iconic events and venues on the global circuit, from Ushuaïa Ibiza and Hï Ibiza to The Sphere in Las Vegas, Time Warp and Afterlife. After previously holding an acclaimed 3-year residency at Hï Ibiza, CamelPhat make their triumphant return with their biggest concept on the island to date. This is not to be missed.

With CamelPhat Presents Summer of Love, Hï Ibiza and CamelPhat will converge in a series of events that elevate production, audiovisual design and musical storytelling to a new level. Ten nights conceived as high-impact immersive experiences, where the duo’s artistic identity and the club’s technical excellence align to transform every Friday into a shared journey through emotionally-charged electronic music. CamelPhat Present Summer of Love, Fridays 1st - 29th May, and 4th September - 2nd October, moving to Sundays 5th July - 30th August 2026 at Hï Ibiza.




CLUB ROOM - Ewan McVicar Presents Club Knuckles (Fridays 1st May - 2nd October 2026).


One of the most exciting names in modern house music lands his first full-length residency at the number one club in the world. After standout sets in previous years, McVicar’s Club Knuckles residency is a testament to his dancefloor devotion and years of hard work.


The award-winning Scottish DJ broke onto the international scene with his 2021 hit “Tell Me Something Good” (DJ Mag’s Track of the Year), and has since dropped heaters like “Miracle Makers” with KETTAMA and the brand new “Share The House”. As well as chart domination, McVicar is making waves with his own festival, Pavilion, and with headline slots and residencies in huge clubs, arenas and festivals across the globe, including Dublin’s 3Arena at the start of 2026.


McVicar’s penchant for making and mixing timeless house music makes him the perfect Club Room resident at Hï Ibiza, and the hitmaker will be a staple on the island for years to come.




CLUB ROOM -Indira Paganotto Presents ARTCORE (Sundays 31st May - 4th October 2026).

After an explosive debut residency in 2025, Indira Paganotto moves to Sunday nights with a residency that will shine a spotlight on her label ARTCORE, and on the psy-techno movement she has helped shape and define on a global scale.

One of the island’s most influential artists and a key figure on the international scene, Paganotto began 2026 with a huge milestone, working together with Beatport to launch the psy-techno category on the platform. This work is a testament to her dedication to the genre and her relentless promotion of the sound into a global force.

Founded in 2023, ARTCORE is one of the creative driving forces of the psy-techno movement, with over 15 releases shaping a distinctive sonic and conceptual aesthetic. In 2025, the label reached a new level with curated stages at some of the world’s biggest festivals, reaffirming its role as a platform for innovation, authenticity and artistic development.

Every Sunday from 31st May - 4th October 2026, Indira Paganotto Presents ARTCORE will transform the Club Room into a temple of psy-techno and high-tempo sounds.



Lineup CamelPhat at Hï Ibiza 2026

The full lineup of guests joining CamelPhat will be announced very soon! Support acts joining Ewan McVicar at the Club Room have already been revealed, featuring the likes of Carl Craig, Ben Hemsley, Skream and Jayda G, among others. On Sundays, Indira Paganotto will be joined by SPFDJ, Ben Klock, Valentinø, Patrick Mason, I Hate Models and many more incredible artists.




Tickets for CamelPhat at Hï Ibiza 2026

Tickets for Camelphat at Hï Ibiza 2026 are now on sale. From only 40 € you can get your Entry Before 1am tickets, while General Admission tickets are available from only 50€. Don't miss out as these sell very fast!

venues.description:
Hï Ibiza information

Opened in 2017 and voted Four-time #1 Club in the World by DJ Mag (2022, 2023, 2024 & 2025), Hï Ibiza is a multi-award-winning nightlife institution located in Platja d'en Bossa, Ibiza. Precision-engineered to push the boundaries of modern clubbing, it connects cultures through diverse music programming and curated art residencies. 2026 residents include Andrea Oliva Presents All I Need, Argy & ARTBAT, Black Coffee, CAMELPHAT Present Summer of Love, Dom Dolla, East End Dubs Presents Eastenderz, Ewan McVicar Presents Club Knuckles, Francis Mercier Presents Solèy, HUGEL Presents Make The Girls Dance, Indira Paganotto Presents ARTCORE, Jonas Blue Presents SENSES, Maz and Antdot Present Dawn Patrol, MEDUZA & James Hype Present OUR HOUSE, MESTIZA, Miss Monique, OFFWEEK, Paco Osuna Presents NOW HERE and Skepta Presents Más Tiempo. Featuring two rooms of headline DJs, a wildcard third dancefloor, breathtaking outdoor terraces, and a first-of-its-kind in-club art gallery. Founded by Yann Pissenem, Owner, Founder & CEO of The Night League and Ushuaïa Entertainment, Ushuaïa Ibiza and [UNVRS], Hï Ibiza runs from May - October each year. This is the world's best multi-room club experience.

Hï Ibiza is comprised of 3 main rooms:


The Theatre: Inspired by classic Italian amphitheatre design, the dancefloor is surrounded by a raised terrace hosting the VIP area. All aspects of this room have been carefully considered to ensure a close connection between the artist and the audience. Each residency is tailored to have a bespoke look and feel, guaranteeing that no two nights are ever the same and the never-before-seen audiovisual production will impress you.

The Club: The underground vibe of the Club Room offers guests a more intimate feel, with a low ceiling boasting incredible lighting installations bathing the darkened room in technicoloured beams of light. With the DJ booth at eye-level clubbers can feel a deeper connection with the artist in an intimate setting.

Wild Corner:Experience the world’s most infamous bathroom: "The Wild Corner." This clandestine spot is where the unexpected comes to life, with impromptu performances by renowned artists. Witnessing The Wild Corner firsthand is an absolute must to grasp its sheer extravagance.


Along with the main rooms, Hï Ibiza has two external areas to relax and socialize. Look out for the secret party at The Wild Corner, the world’s most infamous bathroom.

venues.description:
Information about Playa Soleil Ibiza


Playa Soleil is much more than just a beach club; it’s a unique concept that merges music, art, gastronomy, and wellness in the iconic setting of Playa d’en Bossa, Ibiza. Created by the visionaries behind Ushuaïa and Hï Ibiza, this space redefines bohemian luxury with a design inspired by natural and organic materials, offering a relaxed and sophisticated atmosphere.




Music is the soul of Playa Soleil, with performances by renowned international DJs in its indoor club, Maison Musique. Additionally, quieter days are accompanied by soothing melodies that enhance the gastronomic experience.




With its focus on sustainability, boho-chic style, and exceptional service, Playa Soleil invites its visitors to experience the magic of Ibiza from a unique perspective.

venues.description:
Information about O Beach Ibiza

O Beach Ibiza, previously known as Ocean Beach, is the trendy beach club in San Antonio, hosting some of the most famous pool parties in Ibiza.



Opened in 2012, O Beach Club combines the concept of a glamorous beach club with one of the best sunsets in the Mediterranean. Located just a few meters from the sea, its terrace is the perfect spot to enjoy fun pool parties, featuring a spectacular central pool of 600 square meters, surrounded by numerous sunbeds and VIP tables.



O Beach Club brings an excellent music selection with top DJs. The venue opens at midday with a relaxed vibe, gradually building up as the sun sets, with the party lasting until midnight.



2018 was undoubtedly its breakthrough year, attracting major promoters to host their pool parties at O Beach. Since then, it has maintained top residencies and regularly sells out every day.



Grab your swimsuit and sunglasses, and don’t miss out!



What will you find at O Beach Club Ibiza?

Acrobatics, live performances, and, of course, an unmatched atmosphere that takes you far from your daily routine. Simply let go and follow your instincts—dance to the rhythm of the music or relax on your VIP bed while sipping the most sophisticated cocktails.



Additionally, O Beach offers a variety of glamorous services for a true luxury experience: exquisite fusion cuisine at its restaurant, an exclusive boutique, and, of course, VIP areas to enjoy an unforgettable day.

venues.description:
Discover Bam-Bu-Ku Ibiza


Bam-Bu-Ku Ibiza is a tropical paradise that blends relaxation, gastronomy, music, and entertainment in a spectacular setting. Located in the bay of San Antonio, right next to its sister venue, O Beach, it offers a unique experience for families, couples, and groups of friends of all ages.




One of its main attractions is Ibiza’s only artificial wave, Flowrider, where guests can learn to surf or bodyboard with the help of expert instructors. The club also features an impressive lagoon-style pool surrounded by Balinese beds and sun loungers, perfect for enjoying the Mediterranean sun.




Bam-Bu-Ku’s restaurant blends tropical and Mediterranean flavors, serving fresh and delicious dishes ideal for any time of day. All this is complemented by a varied cocktail menu that perfectly matches the sea views.




Finally, the club also stands out for its diverse events calendar designed for all audiences. From the Summerrockz Pool Party to the Ibiza Brunch Club—an exclusive brunch with live music—to themed parties like El Kiddo, created especially for families, Bam-Bu-Ku offers a unique experience every day of the week.




If you're looking for an unforgettable experience that combines fun, exclusivity, and the true spirit of Ibiza, Bam-Bu-Ku is your ideal destination.

venues.description:
Ibiza Rocks Hotel information

Ibiza Rocks Hotel is an iconic venue in San Antonio, famous for hosting some of the most legendary pool parties on the island. Over the years, Ibiza Rocks has established itself as a key reference point for live music events and daytime parties in Ibiza, particularly popular with the British crowd.




Ibiza Rocks was born in 2005 from the ambitious idea of bringing live rock music to the island. It initially launched as a concert venue, welcoming some of the biggest international bands to perform on its impressive open-air terrace. Artists such as The Prodigy, Madness, The Libertines, Fatboy Slim, Kasabian and Dizzee Rascal have all taken to the Ibiza Rocks stage over the years.




In more recent seasons, Ibiza Rocks Hotel made a strategic shift away from live concerts to focus exclusively on its now world-famous pool parties. This change proved to be a huge success. Recent seasons have featured an outstanding event calendar, including Craig David’s TS5 residency — which sold out week after week — as well as explosive performances from acts like Rudimental.




All Ibiza Rocks Hotel events take place in the venue’s central courtyard. The swimming pool is the heart of the space and has been the scene of countless unforgettable moments, often becoming the target of spontaneous dives by both artists and party-goers alike.




In 2018, the venue underwent a major refurbishment, introducing a new space designed for 360-degree performances, enhanced VIP areas including exclusive party suites, upgraded bars with faster service, and a powerful new VOID sound system to elevate the overall experience.




In 2026, Ibiza Rocks takes its concept even further, evolving into Ibiza Rocks Pool Club. The venue expands its daytime offering to become the perfect place to spend long summer days with friends, combining music, sunshine, poolside vibes and the unmistakable energy of Ibiza — a social hub where the island’s lifestyle truly comes to life.

Eden Ibiza nightclub information

Eden Ibiza is one of the main promoters of San Antonio’s nightlife,a key venue in the clubber history of Ibiza, protagonist of the best night os electronics


Previously known as the Star Club or Kaos, Ibiza stalwarts Pete Tong and Judge Jules are remembered for traditionally holding residencies at the venue before it finally became Eden in 1999.

After a recent refurbishment Eden Ibiza has really come in to its own holding popular residences such as Defected in the House.With a decoration that evokes to the Garden of Eden, the club returns with a new philosophy and another mentality, which is relaunch San Antonio nights.


With cheaper entry and reasonable drinks prices, Eden is a fantastic venue to enjoy deep house and techno on a superclub scale. Located a mere stones throw away from where many party goers and seasonal workers are homed, Eden can guarantee a crowd of familiar faces and a great place to boogie with newfound friends.


Eden nightclub counts on Incubus Gold of Void, a sound system exclusive in Ibiza that could be enjoyed by a crowd of 3000 people. It is divided into a large and sophisticated main room and a second room with independent access. Eden Ibiza also has two cabins, several bars and two VIP areas with private parking.

venues.description:
Information about Es Paradis Ibiza

Es Paradis club, situated on the seafront in San Antonio, is undoubtedly one of the most beautiful clubs in the Mediterranean.




Es Paradis Ibiza opened in 1975 and was created by the artist Lluís Güell, also the creator of Café del Mar




It is built on a huge glass pyramid. Its interior is a spectacular space where the predominant color is the purest white decorated with the most exotic and varied vegetation.


In the hottest suimmer nights, Es paradis can open its roof




The club has two floors with two different rooms, decorated in true Roman style, with columns, palm trees and luxurious marble, predominantly white and very common in Ibiza. It's an icon of the nights in Ibiza and one of those nightclubs that you must visit at least once in your life.




Located in San Antonio, Es Paradis nightclub is focused on a British public, but it is also common to see many residents of the island.




Its most famous and fun party is the Water Party, where water jets are the stars and the dance floor is flooded for everyone to enjoy. In addition, Es Paradis Club presents an extensive calendar of parties and unique experiences every summer




Es Paradis has a wide and diverse offer, three dance floors with three different environments: Café Paradis, The Gallery and the Main Hall. Also it has multiple services: 10 bars, wardrobe, a boutique and four VIP areas

venues.description:
Located between the picturesque hills of Benimussa, in the middle of virgin farmland, lemon orchards, and with elevated views towards the famous sunset in the distance, 528 Ibiza is an impressive blank canvas that invites projecting something magical onto it.



The venue (formerly Benimussa Park) is the perfect setting for the island's most exclusive events, accessible only to a few privileged individuals. It consists of 3 distinct areas:


- Garden: The outdoor area that features bars, gardens, as well as its renowned amphitheater where parties take place.

- Terrace: The ideal place to relax, recharge, and continue the party.

- Theater: The indoor area, renovated in 2021, where private events and gala dinners are held.

venues.description:
Information about Lío Ibiza

Lío Ibiza is not a restaurant, nor a club, nor a cabaret—it's all of them at once! A 360º experience.

Lío Club Ibiza is a complete experience, and it’s no coincidence that this restaurant-cabaret has become one of the most exclusive places in the world.

Since its opening, it has become a must-see in the island's nightlife. Lío is the place for beautiful, sophisticated people, full of VIPs and celebrities. It is a meeting point for actors, singers, and athletes; stars like Leonardo DiCaprio, Sean Penn, and Michael Jordan have visited.



At Lío Ibiza, you’ll find:



A delicious and selective gastronomic offer to enjoy dinner


Amazing cabaret shows, acrobatics, and musical performances... with the particularity that the audience is in constant interaction with the artists


Unique views of Dalt Vila from its prime position on the waterfront


And of course, some of the most fun parties in Ibiza until dawn.


Lío Club Ibiza has luxurious facilities, decorated with notable good taste. It also has a pool inside. Whether for drinks or to dine and enjoy the full show, Lío Ibiza is a unique place you must experience.



The nightclub at Lío Ibiza

Parties at Lío nightclub usually start at 1 AM. In the past season, we found parties with DJ Sebastián Gamboa, his Vintage party, and other events with famous DJs like 2ManyDJs, Felix Da Housecat, Idris Elba, Cathy Guetta... A fun offering for every night of the summer.

venues.description:
Information about Teatro Pereyra

The Teatro Pereyra (also known as Teatro Pereira), located in the heart of Ibiza, is an iconic historic theater that, after years of closure, has been meticulously restored to regain its former glory. Its architecture, which preserves classical elements with contemporary touches, creates a cozy and elegant atmosphere, ideal for enjoying an unprecedented musical performance on the island.


In addition to its exceptional musical programming, Teatro Pereyra stands out for its gastronomic offerings, which include a selection of gourmet dishes inspired by Mediterranean cuisine with a modern twist. Visitors can indulge in exquisite culinary options during performances, in a dedicated space that combines culinary art with the elegance of theater.


The entertainment continues beyond the musical and dinner, as the theater transforms into a vibrant social space where the audience can enjoy handcrafted cocktails and more music until dawn, providing the perfect environment to socialize and enjoy the Ibizan nightlife. Teatro Pereyra, with its innovative approach to combining musical entertainment, high-level gastronomy, and socializing, becomes a must-visit destination for culture and leisure lovers in Ibiza.

:root{
--brand:#b0eed0;
--blue:#cce7ff;
--lilac:#bbc0f9;
--ink:#151515;
--soft:#f2f2f2;
--muted:#667085;
}

.included-row{
display:flex;
flex-wrap:nowrap;
gap:.6rem;
overflow-x:auto;
padding:.4rem .1rem;
margin:.25rem 0 1rem 0;
scroll-snap-type:x proximity;
}
.included-row::-webkit-scrollbar{ display:none; }

.chip{
flex:0 0 auto;
scroll-snap-align:start;
display:inline-flex;
align-items:center;
gap:.55rem;
padding:.55rem .9rem;
border-radius:10px;
font-weight:600;
font-size:.9rem;
line-height:1.05;
background:transparent;
border:1.5px solid var(--blue);
white-space:nowrap;
color:var(--ink);
}

.icon{
width:32px;
height:32px;
border-radius:50%;
display:grid;
place-items:center;
background:var(--blue);
color:var(--ink);
flex-shrink:0;
}

.icon svg{
width:20px;
height:20px;
}

.icon svg.heroicon{
fill:none;
stroke:currentColor;
stroke-width:1.7;
stroke-linecap:round;
stroke-linejoin:round;
vector-effect:non-scaling-stroke;
}

.icon svg.drink-icon,
.icon svg.food-icon,
.icon svg.snorkel-icon{
width:18px;
height:18px;
fill:currentColor;
stroke:none;
}

.icon svg.music-icon{
width:21px;
height:21px;
}

.detalles{ margin:1rem 0; }
.detalles summary{ list-style:none; cursor:pointer; display:inline-block; }
.detalles summary::-webkit-details-marker{ display:none; }

.pill{
display:inline-flex;
align-items:center;
gap:.6em;
background:var(--blue);
color:var(--ink);
padding:.4em .8em;
border-radius:6px;
line-height:1.1;
}

.pill::after{
content:"+";
width:1.3em;
height:1.3em;
border-radius:50%;
background:rgba(255,255,255,.65);
color:var(--ink);
font-weight:700;
font-size:.9em;
display:grid;
place-items:center;
}

details[open] .pill::after{ content:"–"; }

.contenido{
margin-top:.6em;
margin-left:.2em;
animation:fadeIn .25s ease;
}

@keyframes fadeIn{
from{opacity:0; transform:translateY(-4px)}
to{opacity:1; transform:translateY(0)}
}

.cubiculo-lista{
display:flex;
flex-direction:column;
gap:.45em;
}

.cubiculo{
background:var(--lilac);
border:1px solid rgba(21,21,21,.05);
border-radius:10px;
padding:.6em .9em;
font:inherit;
color:var(--ink);
line-height:inherit;
}

.itinerary-block{
--line:var(--lilac);
--dot:var(--ink);
position:relative;
padding:8px 4px 4px 4px;
}

.itinerary-block *{ box-sizing:border-box; }

.itinerary-block .title{
margin:0 0 .6rem 12px;
color:var(--ink);
font-size:1.2rem;
font-weight:700;
}

.itinerary-block .list{
position:relative;
display:grid;
grid-template-columns:56px 1fr;
row-gap:26px;
padding:18px 0;
}

.itinerary-block .line{
position:absolute;
left:28px;
transform:translateX(-3px);
border-left:6px dotted var(--line);
top:18px;
height:0;
pointer-events:none;
}

.itinerary-block .item{ display:contents; }
.itinerary-block .cell-left{ grid-column:1; position:relative; }

.itinerary-block .icon-wrap{
width:36px;
height:36px;
border-radius:50%;
background:#fff;
border:3px solid var(--line);
margin-left:10px;
box-shadow:0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.05);
display:flex;
align-items:center;
justify-content:center;
}

.itinerary-block .badge{
width:26px;
height:26px;
border-radius:50%;
background:var(--dot);
color:#fff;
display:flex;
align-items:center;
justify-content:center;
line-height:0;
}

.itinerary-block .badge svg{
width:15px;
height:15px;
display:block;
}

.itinerary-block .cell-right{ grid-column:2; }

.itinerary-block .h{
font-weight:800;
color:var(--dot);
margin:0 0 .1rem 0;
}

.itinerary-block .sub{
color:var(--muted);
margin:0 0 .35rem 0;
font-size:.94rem;
}

.detalles summary,
.detalles summary *{
outline:none!important;
box-shadow:none!important;
-webkit-box-shadow:none!important;
-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;
}

.trip-ticket{
display:grid;
grid-template-columns:1fr;
gap:.45rem;
background:linear-gradient(135deg, #eefcf4 0%, #b0eed0 100%);
border:1px solid rgba(21,21,21,.06);
border-radius:14px;
padding:1rem 1rem .95rem;
margin:.2rem 0 1.1rem 0;
box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(21,21,21,.06);
}

.trip-ticket .eyebrow{
font-size:.78rem;
font-weight:700;
text-transform:uppercase;
letter-spacing:.04em;
color:#2f6b4f;
}

.trip-ticket .main{
font-size:1.15rem;
font-weight:800;
color:#151515;
line-height:1.2;
}

.trip-ticket .meta{
display:flex;
flex-wrap:wrap;
gap:.5rem .7rem;
margin-top:.1rem;
}

.trip-ticket .meta span{
background:rgba(255,255,255,.78);
border-radius:999px;
padding:.38rem .7rem;
font-size:.9rem;
font-weight:600;
color:#151515;
border:1px solid rgba(21,21,21,.05);
}

@media (min-width: 900px){
.included-row{
flex-wrap:wrap;
overflow-x:visible;
gap:1.2rem 1.2rem;
margin:.55rem 0 1.45rem 0;
padding:.25rem 0;
}

.chip{
margin-bottom:.2rem;
padding:.82rem 1.3rem;
font-size:1rem;
border-radius:14px;
gap:.78rem;
}

.icon{
width:38px;
height:38px;
}

.trip-ticket{
padding:1.45rem 1.6rem 1.35rem;
border-radius:20px;
margin:.45rem 0 1.5rem 0;
gap:.8rem;
}

.trip-ticket .main{
font-size:1.7rem;
line-height:1.15;
max-width:900px;
}

.trip-ticket .meta span{
font-size:1rem;
padding:.52rem .95rem;
}
}

Ibiza Cruise Crush is not just a boat party; it is an experience that captures the essence of Ibiza,
youth and freedom. It is the perfect opportunity to make new friends, enjoy stunning sea views and
dance non-stop to the rhythm of the music.





All the information about Ibiza Cruise Crush


What’s included?


3-hour boat party from 2:30 PM to 5:30 PM.

Open bar on board, depending on your ticket type.

DJ and music on board.

Cruise around the Ibizan coastline.

Swim stop in a turquoise water cove.

Ibiza Party Pack included.






Ticket types



Standard Ticket: open bar with beer, sangria, soft drinks and water.


Premium Ticket: open bar with water, soft drinks, beer, sangria and long drinks
such as rum and coke or vodka lemon.


VIP BED extra: maximum 6 people per bed. The amount paid for the bed is
100% consumable on premium bottles, such as Moët & Chandon champagne on board.






Departure point



Check-in at Hotel Vibra Jabeque.
See map.


Boat departure from Playa d’en Bossa pier.






Check-in & departures


Check-in: 1:00 PM – 2:00 PM at Hotel Vibra Jabeque.

Boat party: 2:30 PM – 5:30 PM.

Duration: 3 hours.

Important: Please arrive within the check-in window to avoid missing the boat.






Itinerary


Visualize your route














Check-in at Hotel Vibra Jabeque

Arrive between 1:00 PM and 2:00 PM to complete check-in before boarding.














Departure from Playa d’en Bossa · 2:30 PM

Board the boat and start the Ibiza Cruise Crush party experience.














Cruise around the Ibizan coastline

Enjoy sea views, music and a fun atmosphere while cruising along the coast.














Swim stop in turquoise waters

Take a break from the party and swim in a beautiful Ibiza cove.














Open bar, DJ and party on board

Dance, enjoy your included drinks and make the most of the Ibiza party atmosphere.














Return · 5:30 PM

Return after three hours of music, drinks and unforgettable fun at sea.











Important information


Check-in: Hotel Vibra Jabeque, from 1:00 PM to 2:00 PM. Boat party from 2:30 PM to 5:30 PM.

Departure: Playa d’en Bossa pier.

Open bar: drinks included depend on the selected ticket type.

function recalc(){
const list = document.getElementById('itList');
const line = document.getElementById('itLine');
if(!list || !line) return;

const icons = list.querySelectorAll('.icon-wrap');

const last = icons[icons.length-1].getBoundingClientRect();
const box = list.getBoundingClientRect();

const y2 = (last.top - box.top) + last.height/2;
line.style.top = y1 + 'px';
line.style.height = Math.max(0, y2 - y1) + 'px';
}

window.addEventListener('resize', recalc);

venues.description:
Ibiza Cruise Crush

Ibiza Cruise Crush is one of the most popular boat parties on the island, specially designed for those looking for a unique experience that combines music, fun, and the vibrant Ibiza atmosphere.



This boat party, which sets sail from the port of Figueretas several days a week (depending on the season), offers a 3-hour experience of music, dancing, and fun on the Mediterranean Sea.


Guests enjoy an open bar with beer, sangria, and soft drinks, while dancing to live music that ranges from commercial hits to R&B and reggaeton.


There is also a swimming stop in the crystal-clear waters of Ibiza.



The party includes a 2-hour pre-cruise brunch by the pool at Hotel Vibra Mare Nostrum, with two free drinks and an all-you-can-eat buffet.



Tickets are available from €80, with VIP options that include private beds, full open bar, and priority boarding.



Cruise Crush is the perfect choice for those looking for a lively party, meeting new people, and enjoying the true spirit of Ibiza from the sea. With a relaxed and fun atmosphere, it's ideal for groups of friends, singles, and couples alike.

:root{
--blue:#cce7ff;
--ink:#0f172a;
--muted:#667085;
--brand:#b0eed0;
}

.included-row{
display:flex; flex-wrap:nowrap; gap:.6rem; overflow-x:auto;
padding:.4rem .1rem; margin:.25rem 0 1rem 0; scroll-snap-type:x proximity;
}
.included-row::-webkit-scrollbar{ display:none; }

.chip{
flex:0 0 auto; scroll-snap-align:start; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:.55rem;
padding:.55rem .9rem; border-radius:10px; font-weight:600; font-size:.9rem; line-height:1.05;
background:transparent; border:1.5px solid var(--blue); white-space:nowrap; color:inherit;
}

.icon{
width:28px; height:28px; border-radius:50%; display:grid; place-items:center;
background:var(--blue); color:#000; flex-shrink:0;
}

.icon svg{
width:20px;
height:20px;
}

.icon svg.heroicon{
fill:none;
stroke:currentColor;
stroke-width:1.7;
stroke-linecap:round;
stroke-linejoin:round;
vector-effect:non-scaling-stroke;
}

.icon svg.drink-icon,
.icon svg.food-icon{
width:18px;
height:18px;
fill:currentColor;
stroke:none;
}

.icon svg.snorkel-icon{
width:20px;
height:20px;
fill:currentColor;
stroke:none;
}

.icon svg.music-icon{
width:21px;
height:21px;
}

.trip-ticket{
display:grid;
grid-template-columns:1fr;
gap:.45rem;
background:linear-gradient(135deg, #eefcf4 0%, #b0eed0 100%);
border:1px solid rgba(21,21,21,.06);
border-radius:14px;
padding:1rem 1rem .95rem;
margin:.2rem 0 1.1rem 0;
box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(21,21,21,.06);
}

.trip-ticket .eyebrow{
font-size:.78rem;
font-weight:700;
text-transform:uppercase;
letter-spacing:.04em;
color:#2f6b4f;
}

.trip-ticket .main{
font-size:1.15rem;
font-weight:800;
color:#151515;
line-height:1.2;
}

.trip-ticket .meta{
display:flex;
flex-wrap:wrap;
gap:.5rem .7rem;
margin-top:.1rem;
}

.trip-ticket .meta span{
background:rgba(255,255,255,.78);
border-radius:999px;
padding:.38rem .7rem;
font-size:.9rem;
font-weight:600;
color:#151515;
border:1px solid rgba(21,21,21,.05);
}

.detalles{ margin:1rem 0; }
.detalles summary{ list-style:none; cursor:pointer; display:inline-block; }
.detalles summary::-webkit-details-marker{ display:none; }

.pill{
display:inline-flex;
align-items:center;
gap:.6em;
background:var(--blue);
color:#000;
padding:.4em .8em;
border-radius:6px;
line-height:1.1;
}

.pill::after{
content:"+";
width:1.3em;
height:1.3em;
border-radius:50%;
background:rgba(255,255,255,.55);
color:#000;
font-weight:700;
font-size:.9em;
display:grid;
place-items:center;
}

details[open] .pill::after{ content:"–"; }

.contenido{
margin-top:.6em;
margin-left:.2em;
animation:fadeIn .25s ease;
}

@keyframes fadeIn{
from{opacity:0; transform:translateY(-4px)}
to{opacity:1; transform:translateY(0)}
}

.cubiculo-lista{
display:flex;
flex-direction:column;
gap:.45em;
}

.cubiculo{
background:#bbc0f9;
border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.05);
border-radius:10px;
padding:.6em .9em;
font:inherit;
color:inherit;
line-height:inherit;
}

.mapa-destacado{
background:var(--blue);
color:#000;
border-radius:8px;
padding:.6em .9em;
font-size:.95em;
line-height:1.4;
margin-top:.6em;
}

.itinerary-block{
--line:#bbc0f9;
--dot:#151515;
position:relative;
padding:8px 4px 4px 4px;
}

.itinerary-block *{ box-sizing:border-box; }

.itinerary-block .title{
margin:0 0 .6rem 12px;
color:var(--ink);
font-size:1.2rem;
font-weight:700;
}

.itinerary-block .list{
position:relative;
display:grid;
grid-template-columns:56px 1fr;
row-gap:26px;
padding:18px 0;
}

.itinerary-block .line{
position:absolute;
left:28px;
transform:translateX(-3px);
border-left:6px dotted var(--line);
top:18px;
height:0;
pointer-events:none;
}

.itinerary-block .item{ display:contents; }
.itinerary-block .cell-left{ grid-column:1; position:relative; }

.itinerary-block .icon-wrap{
width:36px;
height:36px;
border-radius:50%;
background:#fff;
border:3px solid var(--line);
margin-left:10px;
box-shadow:0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.05);
display:flex;
align-items:center;
justify-content:center;
}

.itinerary-block .badge{
width:26px;
height:26px;
border-radius:50%;
background:var(--dot);
color:#fff;
display:flex;
align-items:center;
justify-content:center;
line-height:0;
}

.itinerary-block .badge svg{
width:15px;
height:15px;
display:block;
}

.itinerary-block .cell-right{ grid-column:2; }

.itinerary-block .h{
font-weight:800;
color:var(--dot);
margin:0 0 .1rem 0;
}

.itinerary-block .sub{
color:#637587;
margin:0 0 .35rem 0;
font-size:.94rem;
}

.itinerary-block .cta{
display:flex;
flex-wrap:wrap;
gap:.45rem .7rem;
margin-bottom:.1rem;
}

.itinerary-block .cta a{
text-decoration:underline;
font-weight:600;
color:var(--dot);
}

.detalles summary,
.detalles summary *{
outline:none!important;
box-shadow:none!important;
-webkit-box-shadow:none!important;
-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;
}

.detalles summary:focus,
.detalles summary:focus-visible,
.detalles summary:active,
.detalles summary:focus-within,
.detalles[open]>summary:focus,
.detalles[open]>summary:focus-visible,
.detalles summary:focus-visible>.pill,
.detalles summary:focus>.pill{
outline:none!important;
box-shadow:none!important;
-webkit-box-shadow:none!important;
}

.detalles summary::-moz-focus-inner{ border:0!important; }

@media (min-width: 900px){
.cubiculo-mapa{
max-width:760px;
margin-left:auto;
margin-right:auto;
}

.included-row{
flex-wrap:wrap;
overflow-x:visible;
gap:.6rem .7rem;
}

.chip{
margin-bottom:.2rem;
}

.trip-ticket{
padding:1.45rem 1.6rem 1.35rem;
border-radius:20px;
margin:.45rem 0 1.5rem 0;
gap:.8rem;
}

.trip-ticket .eyebrow{
font-size:.9rem;
}

.trip-ticket .main{
font-size:1.7rem;
line-height:1.15;
max-width:900px;
}

.trip-ticket .meta{
gap:.7rem .8rem;
margin-top:.2rem;
}

.trip-ticket .meta span{
font-size:1rem;
padding:.52rem .95rem;
}
}

Music & sundeck

(function(){
function recalc(){
const list = document.getElementById('itList');
const line = document.getElementById('itLine');
if(!list || !line) return;

const icons = list.querySelectorAll('.icon-wrap');
if(icons.length < 2) { line.style.height = '0px'; return; }

const first = icons[0].getBoundingClientRect();
const last = icons[icons.length-1].getBoundingClientRect();
const box = list.getBoundingClientRect();

const y1 = (first.top - box.top) + first.height/2;
const y2 = (last.top - box.top) + last.height/2;
line.style.top = y1 + 'px';
line.style.height = Math.max(0, y2 - y1) + 'px';
}
window.addEventListener('load', () => setTimeout(recalc, 0), { once:true });
window.addEventListener('resize', recalc);
document.querySelectorAll('.detalles').forEach(d => d.addEventListener('toggle', recalc));
const listEl = document.getElementById('itList');
if(listEl) new MutationObserver(recalc).observe(listEl, {subtree:true, childList:true});
})();

About the Calas de Formentera excursion


Calas de Formentera is a boat excursion from Ibiza to Formentera departing from Playa d’en Bossa.
This full-day experience combines breakfast on board, a swimming stop, free time in Formentera and a final cruise along the coast of Illetas and Espalmador with food, drinks and DJ on board.




The excursion starts with check-in between 9:30 AM and 10:00 AM at the Sea Experience Ibiza stand, located at the departure point in Playa d’en Bossa. After spending the day in Formentera, the boat returns to Ibiza with arrival scheduled at around 9:00 PM.






All the information about Calas de Formentera


What’s included?


Boat excursion to Formentera departing from Playa d’en Bossa.

Breakfast on board: 3 types of bread, crushed tomato, hummus, guacamole, honey, ensaimada, Tarta de Santiago, fruit, coffee, cold brew Baileys, teas and juices.

Dinner on board: 2 types of paella prepared on board as a show-cooking experience, polo-flash, olives, alioli and fruit.

Drinks included: water, soft drinks, beer, sangria and Aperol.

Swimming stop before arriving in Formentera.

Free time in Formentera from 12:00 PM to 6:00 PM.

DJ on board to enjoy the party atmosphere on the boat.






Departure point



Sea Experience Ibiza stand, located at the departure point in Playa d’en Bossa.






Check-in & departures


Check-in: from 9:30 AM to 10:00 AM.

Boarding and departure from Playa d’en Bossa: 10:30 AM.

Disembarkation in Formentera: 12:00 PM, at La Savina port.

Boarding and departure from Formentera: 6:00 PM (5:00 PM from September).

Arrival in Ibiza: 9:00 PM (20:00 PM - 20:30 PM from September).






Itinerary


Visualize your route














9:30 AM – 10:00 AM · Check-in at Sea Experience Ibiza

Check-in takes place at the Sea Experience Ibiza stand, located at the departure point in Playa d’en Bossa.














10:30 AM · Boarding and departure from Playa d’en Bossa

Board the boat and begin the crossing to Formentera.














10:30 AM – 12:00 PM · Breakfast on board and swimming stop

Enjoy breakfast during the trip and a swimming stop before arriving in Formentera.














12:00 PM · Disembarkation at La Savina, Formentera

Arrive at La Savina port and begin your free time on the island.














12:00 PM – 6:00 PM · Free time in Formentera

Explore Formentera at your own pace, visit its beaches, discover the island or relax before returning to the boat.














6:00 PM (5:00 PM from September) · Boarding and departure from Formentera

Return to the boat to begin the final part of the excursion.














6:00 PM – 9:00 PM (5:00 PM - 8:00 PM from September)· Illetas, Espalmador, food, drinks and DJ

Cruise along the coast of Illetas and Espalmador with food, drinks and DJ on board. Time to give it your all on the dance floor!














9:00 PM (8:30 PM from September) · Arrival in Ibiza

End of the excursion after a full day between Ibiza, Formentera, the sea, food, drinks and music.











Important information


Check-in: from 9:30 AM to 10:00 AM at the Sea Experience Ibiza stand.

Departure: 10:30 AM from Playa d’en Bossa.

Arrival port in Formentera: La Savina.

Return: departure from Formentera at 6:00 PM and arrival in Ibiza at 9:00 PM.

The itinerary and times may vary depending on sea conditions, weather or excursion organization.
