(function(){
function recalc(){
const list = document.getElementById('itList');
const line = document.getElementById('itLine');
if(!list || !line) return;

const icons = list.querySelectorAll('.icon-wrap');
if(icons.length < 2) { line.style.height = '0px'; return; }

const first = icons[0].getBoundingClientRect();
const last = icons[icons.length-1].getBoundingClientRect();
const box = list.getBoundingClientRect();

const y1 = (first.top - box.top) + first.height/2;
const y2 = (last.top - box.top) + last.height/2;
line.style.top = y1 + 'px';
line.style.height = Math.max(0, y2 - y1) + 'px';
}

window.addEventListener('load', function(){ setTimeout(recalc, 0); }, { once:true });
window.addEventListener('resize', recalc);

document.querySelectorAll('.detalles').forEach(function(d){
d.addEventListener('toggle', recalc);
});

const listEl = document.getElementById('itList');
if(listEl) new MutationObserver(recalc).observe(listEl, {subtree:true, childList:true});
})();

function recalc(){
const list = document.getElementById('itList');
const line = document.getElementById('itLine');
if(!list || !line) return;

const icons = list.querySelectorAll('.icon-wrap');
if(icons.length < 2) { line.style.height = '0px'; return; }

const first = icons[0].getBoundingClientRect();
const last = icons[icons.length-1].getBoundingClientRect();
const box = list.getBoundingClientRect();

const y1 = (first.top - box.top) + first.height/2;
const y2 = (last.top - box.top) + last.height/2;
line.style.top = y1 + 'px';
line.style.height = Math.max(0, y2 - y1) + 'px';
}
window.addEventListener('load', () => setTimeout(recalc, 0), { once:true });
window.addEventListener('resize', recalc);
document.querySelectorAll('.detalles').forEach(d => d.addEventListener('toggle', recalc));
const listEl = document.getElementById('itList');
if(listEl) new MutationObserver(recalc).observe(listEl, {subtree:true, childList:true});
})();

About A Day In Paradise Ibiza


A Day In Paradise Ibiza is one of the most complete boat trips in Ibiza. Departing from the port of San Antonio, this 5-hour luxury boat excursion takes you along Ibiza’s beautiful west coast, visiting Cala Bassa, Cala Conta and hidden coastal spots along the way. The experience includes 6 drinks, graze boards, fresh fruit, DJ music and water activities for a fun and social day at sea.





All the information about A Day In Paradise Ibiza


What’s included?


5-hour boat trip from 12:00 PM to 5:00 PM.

6 drinks included: soft drinks, beer or wine.

Graze board and fresh fruit served on board.

Water activities: snorkel, paddle surf and inflatables.

Route to Cala Bassa and Cala Conta, including hidden coastal spots.

DJ and music on board.

Swim stop in crystal-clear waters.






Departure point



Departure from San Antonio port. Check-in at Rio Ibiza Bar between 11:00 AM – 11:30 AM.

Check-in & departures




Check-in: 11:00 AM – 11:30 AM at Rio Ibiza Bar (San Antonio port).



Departure: 12:00 PM.



Return: 5:00 PM.



Important: Please arrive within the check-in window to avoid missing the boat.







Itinerary


Visualize your route














Check-in at Rio Ibiza Bar

Arrive at San Antonio port and complete check-in before boarding the boat.














Departure from San Antonio · 12:00 PM

Set sail on a luxury boat and cruise through the crystal-clear waters of San Antonio Bay.














West coast route · Cala Bassa, Cala Conta and secret caves

Explore some of Ibiza’s most beautiful coastal spots, including famous coves and hidden sea caves along the route.














Swim stop · Water toys, drinks and food on board

Enjoy time for swimming, snorkelling, paddle surfing and relaxing on inflatables while making the most of your included drinks and graze boards.














Music builds through the day · Social atmosphere on deck

The vibe starts relaxed and becomes more lively as the trip goes on, with DJ music and a friendly international crowd on board.














Return to San Antonio · 5:00 PM

Head back to port after five hours at sea, having spent one of the best boat days on Ibiza’s west coast.











Important information


Departure point: San Antonio port. Check-in at Rio Ibiza Bar.

Drinks included: 6 per person. Extra drinks available at the bar, cash only.

Vegetarian and vegan options available. Other dietary requirements can be catered for with advance notice.

You may bring extra soft drinks in closed bottles.

Weather policy: trips are weather dependent. Alternatives or refunds are offered if the excursion cannot run.

(function(){
function recalc(){
const list = document.getElementById('itList');
const line = document.getElementById('itLine');
if(!list || !line) return;

const icons = list.querySelectorAll('.icon-wrap');
if(icons.length < 2) { line.style.height = '0px'; return; }

const first = icons[0].getBoundingClientRect();
const last = icons[icons.length-1].getBoundingClientRect();
const box = list.getBoundingClientRect();

const y1 = (first.top - box.top) + first.height/2;
const y2 = (last.top - box.top) + last.height/2;
line.style.top = y1 + 'px';
line.style.height = Math.max(0, y2 - y1) + 'px';
}
window.addEventListener('load', () => setTimeout(recalc, 0), { once:true });
window.addEventListener('resize', recalc);
document.querySelectorAll('.detalles').forEach(d => d.addEventListener('toggle', recalc));
const listEl = document.getElementById('itList');
if(listEl) new MutationObserver(recalc).observe(listEl, {subtree:true, childList:true});
})();

events.description:
Visit one of the most beautiful and magical natural environments on the coast of Ibiza. During this 4-hour Cruise you will be able to discover numerous coves of Ibiza.


The excursion begins with a scenic journey towards Es Vedrà, the island’s largest and most iconic natural reserve. Along the way, you’ll enjoy breathtaking views of some of Ibiza’s most beautiful coves, including Port des Torrent, Cala Bassa, Cala Conta, Cala Tarida, Cala Molí, Cala Vadella, Cala Carbó and Cala d’Hort.



Once you reach Es Vedrà, the boat sails around this spectacular natural landmark while the crew explains its history and legends. Afterwards, depending on sea conditions, you head towards Cala Conta or Cala Bassa, where you can stop for a refreshing swim in crystal-clear waters before making your way back to the port of San Antonio.



The price includes drinks and Finger Food and enjoying one of the best sunsets in the world on your way back to port.




What's included?

- 4h Boat trip from San Antonio to Es Vedrà (4.30pm-8.30pm)


- Sunset


- Local guide on board


- Drinks (water, soft drinks, sangria, white wine and beer)


- Finger Food


- Swim stop at Cala Bassa or Cala Conta (dependig on sea conditions)


- Underwater vision




What to expect San Antonio to Es Vedrà Boat Trip Sunset

Visit one of the most beautiful natural environments in Ibiza. Departing from San Antonio, throughout the route you can admire the beaches of Cala Bassa, Cala Conta, Cala Molí, Cala Vadella, Cala Carbó and Cala D'Hort and the islands of Conejera, del Bosque, Ses Bledes, S'Espartà and Es Vedrà.




Important Information

- Departure from San Antonio port, Captain Nemo kiosk (See map)


- Departure times may vary depending on the time of year


- Recommended for all ages


- There will be a swim stop, so you must bring a swim suit and towel. Bring sun protection, sunglasses, sunscreen, a hat...




If you would like to enjoy this excursion but in the morning, you can book your place here: San Antonio to Es Vedrà Boat Trip Daytime

events.description:
Natural Park Aquarium is a 3 hour boat trip departing from San Antonio from 11:00am to 2:00pm. A trip to the northwest of the island of Ibiza. The first stop is the Cap Blanc Aquarium, an old lobster nursery inside a cave that houses different species endemic to the Pityusic sea. During this route you will see different coves such as Cala Gració, Cala Gracioneta, Cala Salada, Cala Saladeta and Punta Galera. Finally you reach the Margaritas Islands, a nature reserve off the coast of Ses Balandres. It is here that we make a swim stop of approximately 45 minutes where you can use the different aquatic equipment. After the swim stop, you will enjoy a small snack of fruit and salty snacks.

· 3h Boat trip (11:00am - 2:00pm)

· Drinks (water, soft drinks, sangria, white wine and beer)

· Fruits and salty snacks


· Swim stop

:root{
--brand:#b0eed0;
--blue:#cce7ff;
--lilac:#bbc0f9;
--ink:#151515;
--soft:#f2f2f2;
--muted:#667085;
}

.included-row{
display:flex;
flex-wrap:nowrap;
gap:.6rem;
overflow-x:auto;
padding:.4rem .1rem;
margin:.25rem 0 1rem 0;
scroll-snap-type:x proximity;
}
.included-row::-webkit-scrollbar{ display:none; }

.chip{
flex:0 0 auto;
scroll-snap-align:start;
display:inline-flex;
align-items:center;
gap:.55rem;
padding:.55rem .9rem;
border-radius:10px;
font-weight:600;
font-size:.9rem;
line-height:1.05;
background:transparent;
border:1.5px solid var(--blue);
white-space:nowrap;
color:var(--ink);
}

.icon{
width:32px;
height:32px;
border-radius:50%;
display:grid;
place-items:center;
background:var(--blue);
color:var(--ink);
flex-shrink:0;
}

.icon svg{
width:20px;
height:20px;
}

.icon svg.heroicon{
fill:none;
stroke:currentColor;
stroke-width:1.7;
stroke-linecap:round;
stroke-linejoin:round;
vector-effect:non-scaling-stroke;
}

.detalles{ margin:1rem 0; }
.detalles summary{ list-style:none; cursor:pointer; display:inline-block; }
.detalles summary::-webkit-details-marker{ display:none; }

.pill{
display:inline-flex;
align-items:center;
gap:.6em;
background:var(--blue);
color:var(--ink);
padding:.4em .8em;
border-radius:6px;
line-height:1.1;
}

.pill::after{
content:"+";
width:1.3em;
height:1.3em;
border-radius:50%;
background:rgba(255,255,255,.65);
color:var(--ink);
font-weight:700;
font-size:.9em;
display:grid;
place-items:center;
}

details[open] .pill::after{ content:"–"; }

.contenido{
margin-top:.6em;
margin-left:.2em;
animation:fadeIn .25s ease;
}

@keyframes fadeIn{
from{opacity:0; transform:translateY(-4px)}
to{opacity:1; transform:translateY(0)}
}

.cubiculo-lista{
display:flex;
flex-direction:column;
gap:.45em;
}

.cubiculo{
background:var(--lilac);
border:1px solid rgba(21,21,21,.05);
border-radius:10px;
padding:.6em .9em;
font:inherit;
color:var(--ink);
line-height:inherit;
}

.mapa-destacado{
background:var(--blue);
color:var(--ink);
border-radius:8px;
padding:.6em .9em;
font-size:.95em;
line-height:1.4;
margin-top:.6em;
}

/* ========= Itinerary ========= */

.itinerary-block{
--line:var(--lilac);
--dot:var(--ink);
--ring:36px;
--stroke:3px;
position:relative;
padding:8px 4px 4px 4px;
}

.itinerary-block *{ box-sizing:border-box; }

.itinerary-block .title{
margin:0 0 .6rem 12px;
color:var(--ink);
font-size:1.2rem;
font-weight:700;
}

.itinerary-block .list{
display:flex;
flex-direction:column;
gap:0;
padding:18px 0;
}

.itinerary-block .item{
display:grid;
grid-template-columns:56px minmax(0,1fr);
align-items:stretch;
}

.itinerary-block .cell-left{
position:relative;
display:flex;
justify-content:center;
align-items:flex-start;
}

.itinerary-block .cell-left::before,
.itinerary-block .cell-left::after{
content:"";
position:absolute;
left:50%;
transform:translateX(-50%);
width:3px;
background:var(--line);
border-radius:999px;
z-index:0;
pointer-events:none;
}

.itinerary-block .cell-left::before{
top:0;
height:calc(var(--ring) / 2 - var(--stroke));
}

.itinerary-block .cell-left::after{
top:calc(var(--ring) / 2 + var(--stroke));
bottom:0;
}

.itinerary-block .item:first-child .cell-left::before{
display:none;
}

.itinerary-block .item:last-child .cell-left::after{
display:none;
}

.itinerary-block .icon-wrap{
position:relative;
z-index:1;
width:var(--ring);
height:var(--ring);
border-radius:50%;
background:#fff;
border:var(--stroke) solid var(--line);
box-shadow:0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.05);
display:flex;
align-items:center;
justify-content:center;
}

.itinerary-block .badge{
width:26px;
height:26px;
border-radius:50%;
background:var(--dot);
color:#fff;
display:flex;
align-items:center;
justify-content:center;
}

.itinerary-block .badge svg{
width:15px;
height:15px;
display:block;
}

.itinerary-block .cell-right{
min-width:0;
padding:0 0 22px 0;
}

.itinerary-block .item:last-child .cell-right{
padding-bottom:0;
}

.itinerary-block .h{
font-weight:800;
color:var(--dot);
margin:0 0 .1rem 0;
line-height:1.15;
}

.itinerary-block .sub{
color:var(--muted);
margin:0;
font-size:.94rem;
line-height:1.35;
}

.itinerary-block .cta{
display:flex;
flex-wrap:wrap;
gap:.45rem .7rem;
margin-bottom:.1rem;
}

.itinerary-block .cta a{
text-decoration:underline;
font-weight:600;
color:var(--dot);
}

.detalles summary,
.detalles summary *{
outline:none!important;
box-shadow:none!important;
-webkit-box-shadow:none!important;
-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;
}

.detalles summary:focus,
.detalles summary:focus-visible,
.detalles summary:active,
.detalles summary:focus-within,
.detalles[open]>summary:focus,
.detalles[open]>summary:focus-visible,
.detalles summary:focus-visible>.pill,
.detalles summary:focus>.pill{
outline:none!important;
box-shadow:none!important;
-webkit-box-shadow:none!important;
}

.detalles summary::-moz-focus-inner{ border:0!important; }

/* ========= Ticket ========= */

.trip-ticket{
display:grid;
grid-template-columns:1fr;
gap:.45rem;
background:linear-gradient(135deg, #eefcf4 0%, #b0eed0 100%);
border:1px solid rgba(21,21,21,.06);
border-radius:14px;
padding:1rem 1rem .95rem;
margin:.2rem 0 1.1rem 0;
box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(21,21,21,.06);
}

.trip-ticket .eyebrow{
font-size:.78rem;
font-weight:700;
text-transform:uppercase;
letter-spacing:.04em;
color:#2f6b4f;
}

.trip-ticket .main{
font-size:1.15rem;
font-weight:800;
color:#151515;
line-height:1.2;
}

.trip-ticket .meta{
display:flex;
flex-wrap:wrap;
gap:.5rem .7rem;
margin-top:.1rem;
}

.trip-ticket .meta span{
background:rgba(255,255,255,.78);
border-radius:999px;
padding:.38rem .7rem;
font-size:.9rem;
font-weight:600;
color:#151515;
border:1px solid rgba(21,21,21,.05);
}

.trip-ticket .season{
font-size:.92rem;
color:#355070;
line-height:1.45;
margin-top:.15rem;
}

@media (max-width: 768px){
.itinerary-block{
--ring:32px;
--stroke:3px;
}

.itinerary-block .title{
margin-left:0;
}

.itinerary-block .item{
grid-template-columns:42px minmax(0,1fr);
}

.itinerary-block .badge{
width:22px;
height:22px;
}

.itinerary-block .badge svg{
width:13px;
height:13px;
}

.itinerary-block .cell-right{
padding-bottom:18px;
}

.itinerary-block .h{
font-size:1rem;
}

.itinerary-block .sub{
font-size:.9rem;
line-height:1.32;
}
}

@media (min-width: 900px){
.cubiculo-mapa{
max-width:760px;
margin-left:auto;
margin-right:auto;
}

.included-row{
flex-wrap:wrap;
overflow-x:visible;
gap:1.2rem 1.2rem;
margin:.55rem 0 1.45rem 0;
padding:.25rem 0;
}

.chip{
margin-bottom:.2rem;
padding:.82rem 1.3rem;
font-size:1rem;
border-radius:14px;
gap:.78rem;
}

.icon{
width:38px;
height:38px;
}

.icon svg{
width:22px;
height:22px;
}

.trip-ticket{
padding:1.45rem 1.6rem 1.35rem;
border-radius:20px;
margin:.45rem 0 1.5rem 0;
gap:.8rem;
}

.trip-ticket .eyebrow{
font-size:.9rem;
}

.trip-ticket .main{
font-size:1.7rem;
line-height:1.15;
max-width:900px;
}

.trip-ticket .meta{
gap:.7rem .8rem;
margin-top:.2rem;
}

.trip-ticket .meta span{
font-size:1rem;
padding:.52rem .95rem;
}

.trip-ticket .season{
font-size:1rem;
}
}









7–8 hour guided tour








Hotel pickup and drop-off






Island tour of Ibiza








Visit to a hippie market





Multilingual guide



Ibiza bus tour

Island tour of Ibiza · Hippie market, viewpoints and traditional villages


Duration: 7–8 hours
Departure from 9:00 am
Hotel pickup included



About the Ibiza Bus Tour


Let yourself be carried away on a journey that reveals Ibiza’s best-kept secrets. This bus tour around the island visits some of Ibiza’s most iconic spots, including Las Salinas, the Es Vedrà viewpoint, a traditional Ibizan village, and one of the most famous hippie markets on the island. It also includes hotel pickup and drop-off, making it a very convenient option to explore Ibiza in a single day.





All the information about the Ibiza Bus Tour


What’s included?


7–8 hour guided bus tour around the island of Ibiza.

Hotel pickup and drop-off. Important: the meeting point must be confirmed in advance with the company.

On-board guide in Spanish, English, German, French, Dutch and Italian.

Visit to a hippie market: Punta Arabí (Wednesday) or Las Dalias (Saturday).

Important: you must inform the company of your chosen language.






Departure point



The meeting point must be confirmed directly with the company. The tour includes a pickup and drop-off transfer for most hotels on the island of Ibiza.






Schedule and pickups



Tour start time: From approximately 9:20 am.


Transfer pickup: the exact time will depend on the area where you are staying.


Important: on Saturdays there is no pickup in Cala Tarida, Cala Vadella, Portinatx and San Miguel.






Itinerary


View your route













Pickup and tour departure

The experience begins with the previously agreed pickup and departure by bus around 9:00 am.














Ibiza Town · panoramic introduction

A first introduction to the island with a panoramic view of Ibiza Town and allocation to buses according to the chosen language.














Las Salinas · stop

Discover one of Ibiza’s most famous areas, known for its scenery, natural value and unique views.














Es Vedrà viewpoint · panoramic stop

Stop at one of the island’s most iconic viewpoints to admire the views of Es Vedrà.














Traditional Ibizan village · San José or Santa Gertrudis

Walk through one of the island’s most charming villages and discover a more authentic and traditional Ibiza.














Portinatx / San Miguel / Cala San Vicente · free time

Stop to enjoy the surroundings and have free time for lunch. Meal is not included.














Hippie market · Punta Arabí / Las Dalias

Enjoy free time at one of Ibiza’s most iconic hippie markets: Punta Arabí on Wednesdays or Las Dalias on Saturdays.














Return to hotels

After a full day touring the island, the tour ends with the return transfer.











Important information


Departure point: you must contact the company to confirm the exact meeting point.

Transfer included for most hotels on the island of Ibiza.

Tour departure time:From approximately 9:20 am.

Pickup time: may vary depending on the location of your accommodation.

Important: you must inform the company of the language in which you wish to take the excursion. Languages available on board: Spanish, English, German, French, Dutch and Italian.

No Saturday pickup in Cala Tarida, Cala Vadella, Portinatx and San Miguel.

Meal not included during the free time stop.

events.name: Formentera Tour
events.description:
Journey to Formentera from Ibiza with transfer, ferry and Formentera tour included.


Spend a fantastic day in Formentera with this excursion that includes the transfer from your hotel, fast ferry to Formentera and two options: guided tour or bicycle rental to discover the island on your own.




What's included Tour Formentera with bus?

- 8-9 hour approx. tour


- Transfer from your hotel to the Ibiza Port


- Fast ferry to Formentera


- Private tour by bus in Formentera with guide


- Transfer from the Ibiza Port to your hotel




What's included Tour Formentera with bike rental?

- 8-9 hour approx. tour


- Transfer from your hotel to the Ibiza Port


- Fast ferry to Formentera


- Rental bicycle and map with recommendations


- Transfer from the Ibiza Port to your hotel




Formentera tour bus option

A complete tourist tour of Formentera from the port of La Savina to the most popular places on the small island.


- La Savina port (Formentera)


- San Francisco Javier (capital)


- View Point (incredible Formentera views)


- La Mola (views from the cliff and lighthouse)


- Es Pujols Beach


- Free time to have lunch (lunch not included) and swim at the beach


- Formentera salt flats (views to the salt flats from the bus)




LANGUAGES (Bus): Spanish / English / German / French / Dutch / Italian




Formentera tour bicycle option

This option only includes the rental of the bike, a map and recommendations. You have free time to discover the part of Formentera that you prefer

events.name: Las Dalias Night Market
events.description:
Get to know the famous Las Dalias Hippy Market by night

You will visit the famous hippy market of Las Dalias in its nighttime version, which makes it even more special. Departing from the areas of Ibiza and San Antonio, this excursion takes you from the hotel to the hippy market and back.


This tour takes place at night, and during the 4.5h that it lasts, you will have free time to do some shopping, listen to music and fully immerse yourself in the hippie atmosphere of Las Dalias.



What's included?

- 4h30min Tour (aprox.)


- English/Spanish Guide


- Transfer from the hotel* to the hippy market of Las Dalias and back to the hotel

*Transfer service only available from Ibiza and San Antonio areas


- Free time in the hippy market

const list = document.getElementById('itList');
const line = document.getElementById('itLine');
if(!list || !line) return;

const icons = list.querySelectorAll('.icon-wrap');
if(icons.length < 2) { line.style.height = '0px'; return; }

const first = icons[0].getBoundingClientRect();
const last = icons[icons.length-1].getBoundingClientRect();
const box = list.getBoundingClientRect();

const y1 = (first.top - box.top) + first.height/2;
const y2 = (last.top - box.top) + last.height/2;
line.style.top = y1 + 'px';
line.style.height = Math.max(0, y2 - y1) + 'px';
}
window.addEventListener('load', () => setTimeout(recalc, 0), { once:true });
window.addEventListener('resize', recalc);
document.querySelectorAll('.detalles').forEach(d => d.addEventListener('toggle', recalc));

:root{
--brand:#b0eed0;
--blue:#cce7ff;
--lilac:#bbc0f9;
--ink:#151515;
--soft:#f2f2f2;
--muted:#667085;
}

/* ========= Base styles ========= */

.included-row{
display:flex;
flex-wrap:nowrap;
gap:.6rem;
overflow-x:auto;
padding:.4rem .1rem;
margin:.25rem 0 1rem 0;
scroll-snap-type:x proximity;
}
.included-row::-webkit-scrollbar{ display:none; }

.chip{
flex:0 0 auto;
scroll-snap-align:start;
display:inline-flex;
align-items:center;
gap:.55rem;
padding:.55rem .9rem;
border-radius:10px;
font-weight:600;
font-size:.9rem;
line-height:1.05;
background:transparent;
border:1.5px solid var(--blue);
white-space:nowrap;
color:var(--ink);
}

.icon{
width:32px;
height:32px;
border-radius:50%;
display:grid;
place-items:center;
background:var(--blue);
color:var(--ink);
flex-shrink:0;
}

.icon svg{
width:20px;
height:20px;
}

.icon svg.heroicon{
fill:none;
stroke:currentColor;
stroke-width:1.7;
stroke-linecap:round;
stroke-linejoin:round;
vector-effect:non-scaling-stroke;
}

.icon svg.drink-icon{
width:18px;
height:18px;
fill:currentColor;
stroke:none;
}

.icon svg.food-icon{
width:18px;
height:18px;
fill:currentColor;
stroke:none;
}

.icon svg.snorkel-icon{
width:20px;
height:20px;
fill:currentColor;
stroke:none;
}

.icon svg.music-icon{
width:21px;
height:21px;
}

.icon svg.sunset-icon{
width:20px;
height:20px;
fill:none;
stroke:currentColor;
stroke-width:1.8;
stroke-linecap:round;
stroke-linejoin:round;
}

.detalles{ margin:1rem 0; }
.detalles summary{ list-style:none; cursor:pointer; display:inline-block; }
.detalles summary::-webkit-details-marker{ display:none; }

.pill{
display:inline-flex;
align-items:center;
gap:.6em;
background:var(--blue);
color:var(--ink);
padding:.4em .8em;
border-radius:6px;
line-height:1.1;
}

.pill::after{
content:"+";
width:1.3em;
height:1.3em;
border-radius:50%;
background:rgba(255,255,255,.65);
color:var(--ink);
font-weight:700;
font-size:.9em;
display:grid;
place-items:center;
}

details[open] .pill::after{ content:"–"; }

.contenido{
margin-top:.6em;
margin-left:.2em;
animation:fadeIn .25s ease;
}

@keyframes fadeIn{
from{opacity:0; transform:translateY(-4px)}
to{opacity:1; transform:translateY(0)}
}

.cubiculo-lista{
display:flex;
flex-direction:column;
gap:.45em;
}

.cubiculo{
background:var(--lilac);
border:1px solid rgba(21,21,21,.05);
border-radius:10px;
padding:.6em .9em;
font:inherit;
color:var(--ink);
line-height:inherit;
}

.mapa-destacado{
background:var(--blue);
color:var(--ink);
border-radius:8px;
padding:.6em .9em;
font-size:.95em;
line-height:1.4;
margin-top:.6em;
}

/* ========= Itinerary ========= */

.itinerary-block{
--line:var(--lilac);
--dot:var(--ink);
position:relative;
padding:8px 4px 4px 4px;
}

.itinerary-block *{ box-sizing:border-box; }

.itinerary-block .title{
margin:0 0 .6rem 12px;
color:var(--ink);
font-size:1.2rem;
font-weight:700;
}

.itinerary-block .list{
position:relative;
display:grid;
grid-template-columns:56px 1fr;
row-gap:26px;
padding:18px 0;
}

.itinerary-block .line{
position:absolute;
left:28px;
transform:translateX(-3px);
border-left:6px dotted var(--line);
top:18px;
height:0;
pointer-events:none;
}

.itinerary-block .item{ display:contents; }
.itinerary-block .cell-left{ grid-column:1; position:relative; }

.itinerary-block .icon-wrap{
width:36px;
height:36px;
border-radius:50%;
background:#fff;
border:3px solid var(--line);
margin-left:10px;
box-shadow:0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.05);
display:flex;
align-items:center;
justify-content:center;
}

.itinerary-block .badge{
width:26px;
height:26px;
border-radius:50%;
background:var(--dot);
color:#fff;
display:flex;
align-items:center;
justify-content:center;
line-height:0;
}

.itinerary-block .badge svg{
width:15px;
height:15px;
display:block;
}

.itinerary-block .cell-right{ grid-column:2; }

.itinerary-block .h{
font-weight:800;
color:var(--dot);
margin:0 0 .1rem 0;
}

.itinerary-block .sub{
color:var(--muted);
margin:0 0 .35rem 0;
font-size:.94rem;
}

.itinerary-block .cta{
display:flex;
flex-wrap:wrap;
gap:.45rem .7rem;
margin-bottom:.1rem;
}

.itinerary-block .cta a{
text-decoration:underline;
font-weight:600;
color:var(--dot);
}

/* === Remove blue focus halo === */

.detalles summary,
.detalles summary *{
outline:none!important;
box-shadow:none!important;
-webkit-box-shadow:none!important;
-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;
}

.detalles summary:focus,
.detalles summary:focus-visible,
.detalles summary:active,
.detalles summary:focus-within,
.detalles[open]>summary:focus,
.detalles[open]>summary:focus-visible,
.detalles summary:focus-visible>.pill,
.detalles summary:focus>.pill{
outline:none!important;
box-shadow:none!important;
-webkit-box-shadow:none!important;
}

.detalles summary::-moz-focus-inner{ border:0!important; }

/* ========= Ticket ========= */

.trip-ticket{
display:grid;
grid-template-columns:1fr;
gap:.45rem;
background:linear-gradient(135deg, #eefcf4 0%, #b0eed0 100%);
border:1px solid rgba(21,21,21,.06);
border-radius:14px;
padding:1rem 1rem .95rem;
margin:.2rem 0 1.1rem 0;
box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(21,21,21,.06);
}

.trip-ticket .eyebrow{
font-size:.78rem;
font-weight:700;
text-transform:uppercase;
letter-spacing:.04em;
color:#2f6b4f;
}

.trip-ticket .main{
font-size:1.15rem;
font-weight:800;
color:#151515;
line-height:1.2;
}

.trip-ticket .meta{
display:flex;
flex-wrap:wrap;
gap:.5rem .7rem;
margin-top:.1rem;
}

.trip-ticket .meta span{
background:rgba(255,255,255,.78);
border-radius:999px;
padding:.38rem .7rem;
font-size:.9rem;
font-weight:600;
color:#151515;
border:1px solid rgba(21,21,21,.05);
}

.trip-ticket .season{
font-size:.92rem;
color:#355070;
line-height:1.45;
margin-top:.15rem;
}

@media (min-width: 900px){
.cubiculo-mapa{
max-width:760px;
margin-left:auto;
margin-right:auto;
}

.included-row{
flex-wrap:wrap;
overflow-x:visible;
gap:1.2rem 1.2rem;
margin:.55rem 0 1.45rem 0;
padding:.25rem 0;
}

.chip{
margin-bottom:.2rem;
padding:.82rem 1.3rem;
font-size:1rem;
border-radius:14px;
gap:.78rem;
}

.icon{
width:38px;
height:38px;
}

.icon svg{
width:22px;
height:22px;
}

.icon svg.drink-icon,
.icon svg.food-icon{
width:19px;
height:19px;
}

.icon svg.snorkel-icon{
width:21px;
height:21px;
}

.icon svg.music-icon{
width:23px;
height:23px;
}

.icon svg.sunset-icon{
width:22px;
height:22px;
}

.trip-ticket{
padding:1.45rem 1.6rem 1.35rem;
border-radius:20px;
margin:.45rem 0 1.5rem 0;
gap:.8rem;
}

.trip-ticket .eyebrow{
font-size:.9rem;
}

.trip-ticket .main{
font-size:1.7rem;
line-height:1.15;
max-width:900px;
}

.trip-ticket .meta{
gap:.7rem .8rem;
margin-top:.2rem;
}

.trip-ticket .meta span{
font-size:1rem;
padding:.52rem .95rem;
}

.trip-ticket .season{
font-size:1rem;
}
}







3 h boat experience





Drinks included






Lunch included






Formentera west coast





Snorkel, paddle & floats





Guide & chill-out music



Formentera boat experience

Formentera Experience · Transfer to Formentera, 3-hour boat tour, lunch, drinks and free time on the island


Departure from Santa Eularia, Es Canar, Cala Llonga
Tour experience 09:45 AM – 5:00 PM / 6:00 PM
Boat tour 11:00 AM – 2:00 PM



About Formentera Experience


Formentera Experience is a unique boat excursion along the spectacular west coast of Formentera. The experience includes the ferry transfer from Ibiza, with departures from Santa Eulalia, Es Canar or Cala Llonga, followed by a 3-hour boat tour with guide, lunch on board, drinks, a swim stop and water activities. After the excursion, enjoy free time in Formentera before returning to Ibiza at 5:00 PM or 6:00 PM.



All the information about Formentera Experience


What’s included?


Transfer to Formentera with the first ferry from Es Canar, Santa Eulalia or Cala Llonga.

3-hour boat tour around Formentera’s west coast, from 11:00 AM to 2:00 PM.

Guide on board with live commentary in Spanish, English and German.

Drinks included: water, soft drinks, beer and sangria.

Finger food buffet lunch with options for everyone, including vegan, gluten-free and allergy-friendly alternatives with advance notice.

Fresh seasonal fruit served freshly cut on board.

Water activities: swim stop, snorkel equipment, paddle surf and floating mats.

Chill-out music on board.

Free time in Formentera after the excursion.






Departure points




Es Canar: Av. d'es Canar, 51, 07849 Es Canar, Balearic Islands.
View map



Port of Santa Eulalia: departure point at Santa Eulalia port.
View map



Cala Llonga: pier on Cala Llonga beach.
View map







Check-in & departures




From Es Canar: departure at 9:00 AM.



From Santa Eulalia: departure at 9:30 AM.



From Cala Llonga: departure at 9:45 AM.



Important: please arrive at the boarding point 15 minutes before departure.







Itinerary


Visualize your route














Departure from Ibiza

Take the first ferry to Formentera from Es Canar at 9:00 AM, Santa Eulalia at 9:30 AM or Cala Llonga at 9:45 AM.














Arrival at La Savina port

Arrive in Formentera and get ready to start the boat experience from La Savina.














Boat tour from La Savina · 11:00 AM

Set sail on a 3-hour excursion along Formentera’s west coast with live explanations from the guide.














West coast route · Ses Illetes, Cala Saona or Cap de Barbaria

Admire unique coastal landscapes and spectacular views, depending on sea and weather conditions.














Swim stop · Snorkel, paddle surf and floating mats

Stop in a sheltered cove to swim in crystal-clear waters and enjoy the included water activities.














Lunch, drinks and chill-out music on board

Enjoy a finger food buffet, fresh fruit, water, soft drinks, beer, sangria and a relaxed atmosphere on board.














Free time in Formentera · From 2:00 PM

After the excursion, enjoy the island at your own pace until your selected return ferry.














Return to Ibiza · 5:00 PM or 6:00 PM

Choose your return time and travel back to Ibiza after a full day in Formentera.











Important information


Check-in: please arrive at the boarding point 15 minutes before departure.

Duration: 3-hour boat tour from La Savina, from 11:00 AM to 2:00 PM, plus transfer and free time in Formentera.

Languages: guide on board in Spanish, English and German.

Weather policy: the activity is subject to sea and weather conditions.






(function(){
function recalc(){
const list = document.getElementById('itList');
const line = document.getElementById('itLine');
if(!list || !line) return;

const icons = list.querySelectorAll('.icon-wrap');
if(icons.length < 2) { line.style.height = '0px'; return; }

const first = icons[0].getBoundingClientRect();
const last = icons[icons.length-1].getBoundingClientRect();
const box = list.getBoundingClientRect();

const y1 = (first.top - box.top) + first.height/2;
const y2 = (last.top - box.top) + last.height/2;
line.style.top = y1 + 'px';
line.style.height = Math.max(0, y2 - y1) + 'px';
}
window.addEventListener('load', () => setTimeout(recalc, 0), { once:true });
window.addEventListener('resize', recalc);
document.querySelectorAll('.detalles').forEach(d => d.addEventListener('toggle', recalc));
const listEl = document.getElementById('itList');
if(listEl) new MutationObserver(recalc).observe(listEl, {subtree:true, childList:true});
})();

Ibiza + Formentera Boat Trip

Boat trip to Formentera & S’Espalmador from San Antonio


Departure at 10:00 AM
Approx. 11 hours
From San Antonio


Schedule: April (Wednesdays, Fridays & Sundays) · May, June & September every day except Monday · July & August every day.



About this Formentera boat trip


Embark on one of Ibiza’s most authentic boats, built on the island by local people and operated by Excursiones Ibiza. Departing from San Antonio at 10:00 AM, this experience takes you along Ibiza’s most natural and mystical coastline until reaching the magical islet of Es Vedrà. During the trip, you’ll also visit S’Espalmador and Formentera, two nearby paradises of white sand and crystal-clear waters, perfect for swimming and exploring the seabed. The experience includes food, drinks, snorkelling and paddle boards to share.





All the information about this excursion


What’s included?


Boat trip of approximately 11 hours.

Breakfast on board: coffee, juice and pastries.

Lunch: paella prepared on board.

Afternoon snack served during the return journey.

Drinks included throughout the excursion.

Shared snorkelling and paddle board equipment.

Anchoring at S’Espalmador with a swim stop.






Departure point



Departure from San Antonio Port, at the Excursiones Ibiza desk located on the promenade.
View map.






Check-in & departures



Check-in: please arrive at least 30 minutes before departure.



Departure: 10:00 AM from San Antonio.



Duration: approximately 11 hours.



Important: please arrive on time to avoid missing the boat.






Itinerary


Visualize your route














Departure from San Antonio Port · 10:00 AM

Start your journey to Formentera aboard a traditional Ibizan boat.














Southwest coast of Ibiza · breakfast on board

Cruise along much of Ibiza’s coastline while enjoying the included breakfast.














Pass by Es Vedrà

Discover one of Ibiza’s most iconic and mystical landmarks along the route.














Anchoring at S’Espalmador · swim & lunch

Stop for a swim in crystal-clear waters and enjoy lunch on board.














Panoramic tour of Formentera

Admire the coastline of Formentera before arriving at the port and starting your free time on the island.














Arrival in Formentera · free time

Enjoy free time to explore Formentera at your own pace before boarding again for the return to Ibiza.














Return to Ibiza · sunset & snack

On the way back, enjoy the sunset from the boat together with an afternoon snack.

7–8 hours

Ibiza Town & San Antonio harbour



About the Into the Island Combo Tour


There is no better way to discover Ibiza than by land and sea.
This full-day Into the Island experience combines a boat trip, a 4x4 safari, a hike and a magical sunset picnic in front of Es Vedrà.



The adventure starts aboard a powerful semi-rigid boat from San Antonio harbour, sailing through crystal-clear waters, passing the famous “Heaven’s Door” and stopping at hidden spots for swimming and snorkelling.



After the boat trip, continue the journey in a safari-style Land Rover Defender 4x4, exploring secret viewpoints and off-road tracks across the southwest of Ibiza before ending the day with a 1-hour hike and sunset picnic facing the iconic rock of Es Vedrà.





All the information about the Combo Tour


What’s included?


Boat trip with swimming and snorkelling stops.

4x4 safari in a Land Rover Defender.

1-hour hike with secret Es Vedrà viewpoints.

Sunset picnic with homemade sangria.

2 guides who speak Spanish, French and English.

Boat with skipper.

4x4 with driver.

Water, soft drinks and beer onboard.

Snorkelling equipment.

HQ photos and videos.

Insurance included.






Pick-up & drop-off


Pick-up time: around 2:30 PM, depending on the sunset time.

Transfer included from: Ibiza Town and San Antonio harbour.

Drop-off: Ibiza Town.






Prices


Adult price: €250 per adult.

Child price: €175 per child aged 4–11 years.

Visualize your route














Boat trip · Heaven’s Door & hidden spots

Sail from San Antonio harbour, pass Heaven’s Door and stop at secret places for swimming, snorkelling and drinks aboard.














4x4 Safari · Southwest Ibiza

Explore inaccessible off-road tracks and spectacular viewpoints in a safari-style Land Rover Defender.














1-hour hike · Es Vedrà viewpoints

Walk along rocky paths to discover the most beautiful and secret viewpoints facing Es Vedrà.














Sunset picnic in front of Es Vedrà

End the day with a magical sunset picnic and homemade sangria prepared by a catering service.











Important information


Duration: 7–8 hours.

Transfer included from: Ibiza Town and San Antonio harbour.

Drop-off: Ibiza Town.

Languages: Spanish, French and English guides.

align-items:center;
justify-content:center;
line-height:0;

.itinerary-block .badge svg{

height:15px;
display:block;

.itinerary-block .h{
font-weight:800;
color:var(--dot);
margin:0 0 .1rem 0;

color:var(--muted);
margin:0 0 .35rem 0;
font-size:.94rem;
}

display:flex;
flex-wrap:wrap;
gap:.45rem .7rem;

outline:none!important;

-webkit-box-shadow:none!important;
}

.detalles summary::-moz-focus-inner{ border:0!important; }

gap:.5rem .7rem;
margin-top:.1rem;
}

.trip-ticket .meta span{
background:rgba(255,255,255,.78);
border-radius:999px;
padding:.38rem .7rem;
font-size:.9rem;
font-weight:600;
color:#151515;
border:1px solid rgba(21,21,21,.05);
}

.trip-ticket .season{
font-size:.92rem;
color:#355070;
line-height:1.45;
margin-top:.15rem;
}

max-width:760px;

width:19px;

}

.icon svg.music-icon{
width:23px;
height:23px;
}

.icon svg.sunset-icon{
width:22px;
height:22px;
}

.trip-ticket{
padding:1.45rem 1.6rem 1.35rem;
border-radius:20px;
margin:.45rem 0 1.5rem 0;
gap:.8rem;
}

.trip-ticket .eyebrow{
font-size:.9rem;
}

.trip-ticket .main{

.trip-ticket .meta{

font-size:1rem;
}
}

(function(){
function recalc(){
const list = document.getElementById('itList');
const line = document.getElementById('itLine');
if(!list || !line) return;

const icons = list.querySelectorAll('.icon-wrap');
if(icons.length < 2) { line.style.height = '0px'; return; }

const first = icons[0].getBoundingClientRect();
const last = icons[icons.length-1].getBoundingClientRect();
const box = list.getBoundingClientRect();

const y1 = (first.top - box.top) + first.height/2;
const y2 = (last.top - box.top) + last.height/2;
line.style.top = y1 + 'px';
line.style.height = Math.max(0, y2 - y1) + 'px';
}
window.addEventListener('load', () => setTimeout(recalc, 0), { once:true });
window.addEventListener('resize', recalc);
document.querySelectorAll('.detalles').forEach(d => d.addEventListener('toggle', recalc));
const listEl = document.getElementById('itList');
if(listEl) new MutationObserver(recalc).observe(listEl, {subtree:true, childList:true});
})();

About the Chilli Pepper Boat trip


Experience the Chilli Pepper, a boat trip on a classic llaüt around the bay of San Antonio and the most beautiful beaches on the west coast of Ibiza.




Along the way, there is time to swim in crystal-clear water, relax on deck and simply enjoy the peaceful feeling of being surrounded by the sea.




For around three hours, we cruise through the stunning Bay of San Antonio, discovering hidden coves, turquoise waters and dramatic cliffs that define Ibiza’s west coast.




Discover the best hidden spots in Ibiza with a chill out style décor, music and a great atmosphere.






All the information about Chilli Pepper Boat


What's included?


Boat trip on a llaüt departing from San Antonio.

Drinks included: sangria, beer, soft drinks and water.

Spanish tapas and fresh fruit served on board.

Water activities and time to swim in crystal-clear waters.

Secret caves and hidden coastal spots along the route.

Music on board with a relaxed chill out atmosphere.

Departure from San Antonio

Board the traditional Ibizan llaüt at the port of San Antonio and begin your relaxed cruise along Ibiza’s west coast.
















Cruise through San Antonio Bay

Enjoy the calm bay, music on board and views of the coastline before heading towards Ibiza’s west coast beaches.
















Cala Bassa, Cala Conta & secret caves

The usual route visits Cala Bassa, Cala Conta and secret caves, with turquoise waters and beautiful coastal scenery.
















Alternative route to Cala Salada

If wind or sea conditions are unfavourable, the captain may change the route towards Cala Salada and nearby sheltered coves.
















Swimming stop, tapas & drinks

Stop to swim, relax on deck and enjoy Spanish tapas, fresh fruit and drinks included during the trip.
















Return to San Antonio

Head back to port after around three hours at sea, having enjoyed one of Ibiza’s most relaxed boat experiences.

events.description:
Anyma Presents ÆDEN at [UNVRS]

Following a fully sold-out debut season, Anyma returns to [UNVRS] on Tuesdays, June - September, with ÆDEN, a new residency concept and a deeply immersive creative experience. The residency at [UNVRS] forms part of the ÆDEN Global Tour 2026, which will take Anyma’s new show to a limited and carefully curated selection of stages worldwide, following his debut as a headliner at Coachella. In Ibiza, however, ÆDEN unfolds as a unique immersive experience, designed to fully utilise the power of the hyperclub, where architecture, technology, sound and audience interact in real time to create a direct and conscious connection with the dancefloor.


Matteo Milleri, the creative force behind Anyma, has established himself as one of the most influential figures in contemporary electronic music. After making history as the first electronic artist to hold a residency at Sphere Las Vegas, and following the international impact of his [UNVRS] residency in 2025, he continues to push the boundaries between music, technology and immersive experience.


His work explores essential themes such as technology, nature, humanity and coexistence, developed across the Genesys album trilogy, Genesys (2023), Genesys II (2024, Afterlife/Interscope) and The End of Genesys, and now evolving into ÆDEN, a new creative phase that deepens these ideas and opens new paths of artistic exploration.

Swedish House Mafia play Ushuaïa Ibiza every Sunday from 28th June - 13th September 2026

Legendary supergroup Swedish House Mafia make a long-awaited return to Ibiza with an exclusive Sunday residency at Ushuaïa Ibiza. After delivering groundbreaking headline performances in 2022 and 2023 and an explosive six-date residency in 2024, this special 2026 residency will see them perform over 12 Sundays at the world’s best open-air venue.


The influential Scandinavian trio is made up of DJ producers Axwell, Steve Angello and Sebastian Ingrosso, each one an acclaimed artist in their own right. After joining forces in 2008 they delivered an unparalleled run of hits, including, “One” featuring Pharrell and “Save The World”, and “Don’t You Worry Child”, topping charts, radio play and clubs and festivals around the world. As a group, the Swedes have been in DJ Mag’s Top 100 DJs every year since 2010, including making it into the coveted Top 10.


After a hiatus in 2013, they came back together in 2018 with a string of stadium-sized anthems, such as “Ray of Solar” and “See The Light”, and “Turn On The Lights again” with Fred Again.. Their highly anticipated debut album, Paradise Again was released in 2022 and showcased their artistry and forward-thinking ethos.


The pairing of Swedish House Mafia’s supersized sounds and Ushuaïa Ibiza’s breathtaking production levels will ensure these events will be a highlight of the summer for dance music fans from across the globe.

events.description:
Black Coffee plays at Hï Ibiza every Saturday in the Theatre, while Skepta brings Más Tiempo to the Club Room


THEATRE - Black Coffee


The artist behind one of the most influential sounds of our time returns for an 8th year of his flagship Saturday night residency at Hï Ibiza, renewing a partnership that has become a symbol of the island for its influence on contemporary electronic music.


A singular figure in electronic music, Black Coffee’s blend of African roots, Afropolitan sensibility and decades-honed musical intuition positioned him as a pioneer of Afro House long before it entered global consciousness. He became the first African artist to win the GRAMMY for Best Dance/Electronic Album for Subconsciously, a milestone that solidified his role as a global ambassador for African sounds.

The relationship between Black Coffee and Hï Ibiza began in 2017, the club’s inaugural year. Founded on a visionary belief that Ibiza was ready for a new sound, embodied by a new headline resident DJ and tastemaker. This collaboration has grown to become one of the island’s defining residencies: sophisticated, emotional and deeply connected to the dancefloor, embraced by an international audience that understands music as a transformative journey.

Each season Black Coffee invites artists, filmmakers and creative talents from across the African art scene to shape the visual universe of the residency.




CLUB ROOM - Skepta Presents Más Tiempo


Grime pioneer Skepta brings his house-focused label and event brand Más Tiempo to Hï Ibiza with a new Saturday night residency in the Club Room. For over two decades, Skepta has reshaped the global reach of British music. A rapper, producer, creative director and cultural entrepreneur, his career has been instrumental in taking grime from London’s pirate radio underground to the centre of global music culture. He founded the influential collective Boy Better Know and won the coveted Mercury Prize.


In recent years Skepta has expanded his artistic language into electronic music and club culture. Conceived as a creative platform to explore new textures within contemporary house music, Más Tiempo embodies a different aspect of Skepta’s sonic universe: warm grooves, uplifting energy and a vision deeply rooted in the collective experience of the club.




Lineup Black Coffee at Hï Ibiza 2026

Black Coffee brings an extraordinary cast of guests to his residency: Dixon, Damian Lazarus, Guy Gerber, Kabza De Small, Kerri Chandler, Loco Dice and CamelPhat headline a list that also features ANOTR, Dubfire, Henrik Schwarz, Marco Carola, WhoMadeWho and many more. From deep Afro house to raw techno, every Saturday is a different journey, and the full A-Z guarantees there is something for everyone.

Tickets for Black Coffee are now on sale starting from 80€ for Entry Before 1am tickets, or 100€ for General Admission tickets. If you're looking for a Premium experience, VIP tickets ara available for 1000€. Don't miss out as these sell very fast!

THEATRE - MEDUZA & James Hype present OUR HOUSE


MEDUZA & James Hype Present OUR HOUSE at Hï Ibiza on Wednesday 27th May - 30th September 2026. Highly acclaimed DJs and producers, MEDUZA and James Hype, return to the world’s number one club for their fourth season as Hï Ibiza residents. Now moving to midweek their OUR HOUSE residency will take over the Theatre every Wednesday from 27th May to 30th September.Built on a foundation of authentic musical experience, OUR HOUSE will explore the full spectrum of house music, bridging the gap between underground intensity and main-stage energy.

Italian trio MEDUZA will deliver their electrifying hybrid live concept, MEDUZA³ each week. Blending the art of DJing with live piano, cutting-edge MIDI controls, and dynamic performance elements, this innovative show offers an entirely fresh approach to experiencing electronic music. Luca de Gregorio, Mattia Vitale and Simone Giani perform together, seamlessly fusing live and digital instrumentation. The most streamed Italian artists of all time, MEDUZA, have conquered global charts with their emotionally-charged anthems, including “Lose Control”, “Piece Of Your Heart” and “Bad Memories”.


UK tastemaker James Hype will return with his trailblazing SYNC concept, upgraded for 2026. This unique show fuses innovative technology with James Hype’s high-octane mixing style to visualise his signature DJ tricks, via a custom lighting array that flawlessly synchronises with his actions on the decks. It transforms and enhances the dynamic audio-visual experience, creating an unparalleled and high-energy atmosphere, perfectly suited to the relentless performance style of James Hype. As a producer, he has over 10 million monthly listeners on Spotify and two UK Top 10 hits in “More Than Friends” and “Ferrari”. Don’t miss MEDUZA & James Hype Present OUR HOUSE. Wednesdays at Hï Ibiza 27th May - 30th September 2026.



CLUB ROOM - OFFWEEK (27/05/26 - 29/07/26)


For the first time in its history, OFFWEEK leaves Barcelona to deliver a debut Ibiza residency at the world’s #1 club. The cutting-edge curation that has made OFFWEEK one of the global destinations for electronic music will be in full effect across 10 unmissable nights. This exclusive residency, which celebrates the 10th year of OFFWEEK, will showcase the most exciting artists and tastemakers from across house, techno and beyond.




CLUB ROOM - Jonas Blue Presents SENSES (05/08/26 - 30/09/26)


Jonas Blue’s new concept, SENSES, blends melodic electronic music, global influences and an immersive experience tailored for the Club Room. Inspired by pioneering spaces such as teamLab in Japan and the Las Vegas Sphere, this new multi-sensory experience blends music, visuals, atmosphere and the senses to create a fully immersive environment that showcases the artistic evolution of Jonas Blue. Since emerging as a global force in electronic music, Jonas Blue has built a catalogue surpassing 22 billion streams, establishing himself as one of the world’s leading dance artists. In 2026, Jonas enters a new creative phase, led by the release of “Edge Of Desire”, a record that signals confidence, evolution, and renewed focus. With a club-focused music policy and a night that champions the closeness between artist and audience, this special 9-night run will be one of the highlights of the 2026 season.


Don’t miss Jonas Blue Presents SENSES, Wednesdays, 5 August to 30 September 2026, in the Hï Ibiza Club Room.

Meduza and James Hype headline the season at the Theatre, joined by an exceptional roster that spans the full spectrum of house and electronic music: Anna Tur, The Blessed Madonna, Eli & Fur, Korolova, Magdalena, Maya Jane Coles, Nora En Pure, Pauza, Sam Divine, TSHA and many more.

And the energy doesn't stop there. from May 27 to July 29, the Club Room turns up the heat as OFFWEEK takes over with a stellar lineup featuring Zamna Sound System, Benny Benassi,Agents Of Time, Recondite, Helena Hauff, Alok and many more.

events.description:
Sundays at Hï Ibiza bring MESTIZA to the Theatre, while Indira Paganotto presents ARTCORE in the Club Room

THEATRE - MESTIZA


In a historic moment for electronic music, MESTIZA take control of the Hï Ibiza Theatre for an 11-date residency, becoming the first female artists to lead a summer residency at the world’s number one club. The Spanish duo are known for an artistic vision that fuses tradition and electronic avant-garde, combining flamenco roots with high-impact contemporary production and a deeply emotional dancefloor narrative.

Last year, the duo delivered a highly impactful residency during the opening stretch of the season, alongside standout performances at Ushuaïa Ibiza and [UNVRS]. This year, they return with a full-season residency that cements their legacy on the island.

Since their formation in 2021, MESTIZA have developed a distinctive sonic identity that builds a bridge between the ancestral and the futuristic, where house, melodic techno and Latin grooves intertwine with Spanish percussion and the emotional intensity of flamenco. Their debut album, “Quëreles”, debuted at number one in Spain in its first week, and their second studio album, “Spanish Chica”, is due to drop in April 2026. That same month, they will make history again as the only female Spanish artists to perform at Coachella.

MESTIZA's vision connects cultural heritage with the cutting edge of global electronic music, which aligns naturally with Hï Ibiza’s ethos of Connecting Cultures. Don’t miss their residency 31st May - 5th July and from 6th September - 4th October 2026.



CLUB ROOM - Indira Paganotto Presents ARTCORE


After an explosive debut residency in 2025, Indira Paganotto moves to Sunday nights with a residency that will shine a spotlight on her label ARTCORE, and on the psy-techno movement she has helped shape and define on a global scale.

One of the island’s most influential artists and a key figure on the international scene, Paganotto began 2026 with a huge milestone, working together with Beatport to launch the psy-techno category on the platform. This work is a testament to her dedication to the genre and her relentless promotion of the sound into a global force.

Founded in 2023, ARTCORE is one of the creative driving forces of the psy-techno movement, with over 15 releases shaping a distinctive sonic and conceptual aesthetic. In 2025, the label reached a new level with curated stages at some of the world’s biggest festivals, reaffirming its role as a platform for innovation, authenticity and artistic development.



Lineup for MESTIZA and Indira Paganotto at Hï Ibiza 2026

MESTIZA return with a carefully curated roster. MoBlack, Jan Blomqvist, Patrick Mason, Joezi, Nooriyah lead a lineup that spans the full spectrum of the Mestiza sound, joined by Apache, Dan Tanev, Drush, Faul & Wad, Marten Lou, Pole Position, and many more.


Meanwhile, Indira Paganotto headlines a season that brings some of the most respected names in techno and underground electronic music to the Club Room. HUGEL and Miss Monique return to Hï Ibiza, on Thursdays from the 4th June to the 24th September 2026.

THEATRE - HUGEL Presents Make The Girls Dance


Latin house instigator HUGEL returns with his Make The Girls Dance residency, bringing the most infectious, relentless party energy to the Theatre. After an incendiary debut last year, the producer behind “I Adore You”, “Loosen Up”, “Jamaican (Bam Bam)” and more will be serving up nonstop Latin rhythms, alongside a curated crew of groove-obsessed selectors.


Hailing from the multicultural port city of Marseille, France, HUGEL embraces the rhythms he grew up around. Influences from classic Latin house and Afro house, as well as other hypnotic global sounds, can be heard in his productions and he brings it all together in his spectacular DJ sets.


In 2025, HUGEL lit up the Theatre every week and summoned Latin house devotees and passionate dancers to party with him all night long. As an artist who is fast becoming an Ibiza favourite, he even DJed in a local supermarket on the island making for a one-of-a-kind livestream. Catch HUGEL’s Make The Girls Dance in full flight every Thursday from 4th June - 24th September 2026.



CLUB ROOM - Miss Monique


The Ukrainian progressive house sensation has been on an unstoppable rise through the electronic music scene in recent years. She’s building a momentum that can’t be ignored, releasing heaters like “Nomacita” and “Concorde”, heading up Siona Records, and playing clubs and festivals all over the world alongside the likes of David Guetta and Solomun.


Her Club Room takeovers in 2025 cemented her as part of Hï Ibiza’s heavyweight crew. Bathed in green light, Miss Monique shaped the residency with her signature blend of progressive house, melodic techno, and deep, club-ready rhythms. In 2026, Miss Monique returns to guide you into her world every Thursday, with the help of her favourite DJs from the Siona roster and beyond.

events.description:
Francis Mercier brings Solèy to Hï Ibiza's Theatre every Monday, with Andrea Oliva presenting All I Need in the Club Room

THEATRE - Francis Mercier presents Soléy


The Haitian DJ and producer shapes a sonic ritual that transforms Mondays into an evocative realm where the sounds of the Levant, Africa, and the Caribbean collide.

A musical powerhouse, Francis Mercier, prioritises artistic identity, cultural roots, and emotion over fleeting trends. His globally renowned hits, including “Sauti”, “Premier Gaou (Nitefreak Remix)”, and “Kamili”, as well as his entire discography, have collectively surpassed over 500 million streams. Each release embodies the same philosophy: music deployed to reach all cultures and corners of the world.

​Solèy, which means “sun” in Haitian Creole, is a global community that Mercier has taken to Paris, London, Mumbai, LA, Ibiza, Tulum, and even the Giza Pyramids in Egypt. It’s a movement that connects cultures through joy and movement. This debut residency at Hï Ibiza will see Solèy come to life in the world’s #1 club.

Each week, Mercier will guide the dancefloor on a multicultural journey across cultures, sounds, and generations, expertly blending African and Caribbean roots with Arabic, Latin, and European influences into a vibrant, energetic, and organic house language.

The Solèy experience goes beyond DJ sets, with live guitar, djembe, and choreographed dance performances woven into each event. These add new layers of cultural and artistic expression to the residency.

CLUB ROOM - Andrea Oliva presents All I Need
A certified Ibiza institution, Andrea Oliva is a respected tastemaker known for his masterful command of the dancefloor. His signature sound unties deep rhythms with emotionally resonant anthems for an experience that puts the music first.

All I Need is his label, event and apparel brand that embodies Oliva’s fearless self expression at clubs and festivals across the globe. This moment carries special meaning, as the Club Room at Hï Ibiza was where Andrea held his first Ibiza residency, during the venue’s opening year. Returning now with All I Need represents a full circle moment, this time not only as an artist, but at the helm of a globally established brand with its own identity, community, and clearly defined creative vision.

The residency at Hï Ibiza reflects this evolution. Every Monday, the Club Room will host carefully curated lineups combining exciting emerging talents with established international headliners, all aligned with the musical direction and spirit of the brand, bringing an irresistible vibe to the Club Room on Monday nights.



Lineup Francis Mercier presents Solèy Hï Ibiza 2026

The residency is powered by a carefully curated lineup of global heavyweights and rising talent. Standout names include Diplo, Kölsch, Henrik Schwarz, Jan Blomqvist, LP Giobbi, Sébastien Léger, Satori and Raxon, alongside Afro house leaders such as THEMBA, Shimza, Da Capo, Enoo Napa, Kitty Amor and MoBlack.


It also features iconic collaborations and special B2B moments, with artists like ANANÉ & Louie Vega, Major League DJz, Sparrow, Afrojack, Mahmut Orhan, Kasango and Notre Dame, delivering a diverse and forward-thinking musical journey throughout the season.

East End Dubs’ Eastenderz and Paco Osuna’s NOW HERE take over Tuesdays at Hï Ibiza, marking Eastenderz’s debut season alongside the return of NOW HERE for its fifth year in the Club Room


THEATRE - Eastenderz


In Ibiza, the energy never stops. It transfers, connects, amplifies, and stays with you long after you’ve left the island. In 2026, Eastenderz will harness that same energy for their new residency at Hï Ibiza.


This debut Eastenderz residency will serve as an active power source, with energy transferred from DJ to dancefloor and back again. Leading the project is East End Dubs, the London-based DJ, producer, and creative force behind Eastenderz, who presents a residency where music comes first. With a sonic identity that moves primarily through deep tech and minimal house, infused with dub, garage, and groove, embodies by tracks like Eastenderz brings a soundtrack precision-engineered for the dancefloor.


Experience the raw energy of Eastenderz, every Tuesday from 2 June to 6 October.




CLUB ROOM - Paco Osuna presents NOW HERE


His longest season to date will see Osuna deliver a residency built on the foundations of presence, musical openness and a deep connection with the dancefloor. NOW HERE celebrates that precise moment when everything aligns: sound, body, light and emotion. For Paco Osuna, Ibiza was never just another destination. When he first set foot on the island in the late 1990s, it marked a vital and creative revelation. “Ibiza changed my outlook on life and opened my mind,” he has stated.


Each week, Paco Osuna will take the reins of the Club Room, delivering his signature hybrid live/DJ sets that showcase his boundless creativity and impeccable music taste. Osuna approaches the booth not to prove anything, but to share: music, energy, learning and evolution with a dancefloor that responds when it feels something real is happening. Throughout the season, Paco Osuna will be joined by a carefully curated selection of emerging artists and established figures from across the global scene, for a music programme that does not chase trends or anchor itself in the past, but is built firmly in the present.

CamelPhat Present Summer of Love at the Theatre of Hï Ibiza on Fridays, while Ewan McVicar Presents Club Knuckles in the Club Room

THEATRE - CamelPhat Present Summer of Love


The UK duo are one of the most in-demand names in house music, with world-conquering productions spanning melodic, tech and deep. CamelPhat return to the island with Summer of Love, a celebration of human connection and the energy that lives between people on the dancefloor. It’s not about genres or moments, but what happens when the music takes hold, losing yourself in the dance and finding each other in the process. A night built for remembering why we come to Ibiza in the first place.

Immerse yourself in their back catalogue, which spans certified anthems, including “Breathe”, “Panic Room” and “The Sign”. GRAMMY-nominated and multi-platinum certified, CamelPhat have headlined some of the most iconic events and venues on the global circuit, from Ushuaïa Ibiza and Hï Ibiza to The Sphere in Las Vegas, Time Warp and Afterlife. After previously holding an acclaimed 3-year residency at Hï Ibiza, CamelPhat make their triumphant return with their biggest concept on the island to date. This is not to be missed.

With CamelPhat Presents Summer of Love, Hï Ibiza and CamelPhat will converge in a series of events that elevate production, audiovisual design and musical storytelling to a new level. Ten nights conceived as high-impact immersive experiences, where the duo’s artistic identity and the club’s technical excellence align to transform every Friday into a shared journey through emotionally-charged electronic music. CamelPhat Present Summer of Love, Fridays 1st - 29th May, and 4th September - 2nd October, moving to Sundays 5th July - 30th August 2026 at Hï Ibiza.




CLUB ROOM - Ewan McVicar Presents Club Knuckles (Fridays 1st May - 2nd October 2026).


One of the most exciting names in modern house music lands his first full-length residency at the number one club in the world. After standout sets in previous years, McVicar’s Club Knuckles residency is a testament to his dancefloor devotion and years of hard work.


The award-winning Scottish DJ broke onto the international scene with his 2021 hit “Tell Me Something Good” (DJ Mag’s Track of the Year), and has since dropped heaters like “Miracle Makers” with KETTAMA and the brand new “Share The House”. As well as chart domination, McVicar is making waves with his own festival, Pavilion, and with headline slots and residencies in huge clubs, arenas and festivals across the globe, including Dublin’s 3Arena at the start of 2026.


McVicar’s penchant for making and mixing timeless house music makes him the perfect Club Room resident at Hï Ibiza, and the hitmaker will be a staple on the island for years to come.




CLUB ROOM -Indira Paganotto Presents ARTCORE (Sundays 31st May - 4th October 2026).

After an explosive debut residency in 2025, Indira Paganotto moves to Sunday nights with a residency that will shine a spotlight on her label ARTCORE, and on the psy-techno movement she has helped shape and define on a global scale.

One of the island’s most influential artists and a key figure on the international scene, Paganotto began 2026 with a huge milestone, working together with Beatport to launch the psy-techno category on the platform. This work is a testament to her dedication to the genre and her relentless promotion of the sound into a global force.

Founded in 2023, ARTCORE is one of the creative driving forces of the psy-techno movement, with over 15 releases shaping a distinctive sonic and conceptual aesthetic. In 2025, the label reached a new level with curated stages at some of the world’s biggest festivals, reaffirming its role as a platform for innovation, authenticity and artistic development.

Every Sunday from 31st May - 4th October 2026, Indira Paganotto Presents ARTCORE will transform the Club Room into a temple of psy-techno and high-tempo sounds.



Lineup CamelPhat at Hï Ibiza 2026

The full lineup of guests joining CamelPhat will be announced very soon! Support acts joining Ewan McVicar at the Club Room have already been revealed, featuring the likes of Carl Craig, Ben Hemsley, Skream and Jayda G, among others. On Sundays, Indira Paganotto will be joined by SPFDJ, Ben Klock, Valentinø, Patrick Mason, I Hate Models and many more incredible artists.

Get ready to enjoy top-tier resident DJs and world-class guest artists, all while taking in the spectacular ocean views.

ZUVA returns to O Beach Ibiza in 2026


Following its spectacular debut in 2025, ZUVA returns to O Beach Ibiza for five dates in 2026, bringing a fresh wave of energy to the island’s daytime scene. The event dates are: May 11, June 8, August 10 and 31, and September 14.




Taking its name from the Shona word for sun and daylight, ZUVA channels warmth and light into a soundscape where Afro-house rhythms flow effortlessly with Latin-house grooves.




Get ready for live musicians, standout performances, and flawless DJ sets that create a vibrant atmosphere from the first beat to the last splash. This is a new kind of Ibiza gathering, uplifting, fresh, and deeply rhythmic.




ZUVA celebrates the roots of two rich musical cultures while embracing O Beach’s signature style, creating a dancefloor where every note and drumbeat feels alive. Under the open sky and golden sun, O Beach becomes the perfect stage for a day as radiant as the event’s name.

O Beach Music makes its debut on Thursdays at O Beach Ibiza in 2026

O Beach Music arrives in 2026 as one of the standout new additions to O Beach Ibiza’s calendar. This brand-new Thursday residency is born as a natural extension of the club’s unmistakable sound, becoming the official starting point of the weekend on the island, blending quality house music with O Beach’s unique poolside energy.



Every Thursday, from 21 May to 1 October, the O Beach Music label takes over the club with a carefully curated selection of resident DJs, established producers and emerging talent, delivering a musical experience focused on feel-good house and those tracks that already form part of Ibiza’s summer soundtrack.



Since its launch in 2024, O Beach Music has released music from artists such as Grant Collins, Lucy Jane, Parris Taylor and Marvin Humes, establishing itself as a label that perfectly represents the spirit of the club. In 2026, O Beach takes things one step further by dedicating an entire day of the week to celebrating its musical identity and the artists who ignite the dancefloor from early afternoon.



The experience goes far beyond the music: vibrant productions, striking performances and the unmistakable atmosphere of O Beach Ibiza accompany every edition, creating the perfect setting to dance under the sun until sunset.

Galactica is one of the most compelling projects landing in Ibiza this summer. Born originally as a party at the legendary Italian club Cocoricò, synonymous with cutting-edge techno and house, the brand has grown rapidly to become a benchmark of the European underground. Conceived as the first Italian hard techno travelling festival, Galactica has already passed through key venues such as Nexus in Paris, E1 in London and Fabrik in Madrid. From just €38 (child ticket €19), you can book your seat on this ferry that takes you to Formentera. The journey takes between 50 minutes and 1 hour 15 minutes. You can depart from Figueretas or Playa d'en Bossa, whichever is more convenient for you, as the same boat stops first at the Figueretas pier and 15 minutes later picks up passengers at the Playa d'en Bossa pier.




After sailing with incredible views of Ibiza and Formentera, you will arrive at the port of La Savina in Formentera.




Once on land, you'll find different companies to rent a car, motorbike or bicycle so that you can move freely and explore the whole island.

About the Calas de Formentera excursion


Calas de Formentera is a boat excursion from Ibiza to Formentera departing from Playa d’en Bossa.
This full-day experience combines breakfast on board, a swimming stop, free time in Formentera and a final cruise along the coast of Illetas and Espalmador with food, drinks and DJ on board.




The excursion starts with check-in between 9:30 AM and 10:00 AM at the Sea Experience Ibiza stand, located at the departure point in Playa d’en Bossa. After spending the day in Formentera, the boat returns to Ibiza with arrival scheduled at around 9:00 PM.






All the information about Calas de Formentera

What’s included?


Boat excursion to Formentera departing from Playa d’en Bossa.

Breakfast on board: 3 types of bread, crushed tomato, hummus, guacamole, honey, ensaimada, Tarta de Santiago, fruit, coffee, cold brew Baileys, teas and juices.

Dinner on board: 2 types of paella prepared on board as a show-cooking experience, polo-flash, olives, alioli and fruit.

Drinks included: water, soft drinks, beer, sangria and Aperol.

Swimming stop before arriving in Formentera.

Free time in Formentera from 12:00 PM to 6:00 PM.

DJ on board to enjoy the party atmosphere on the boat.




Departure point



Sea Experience Ibiza stand, located at the departure point in Playa d’en Bossa.




Check-in & departures


Check-in: from 9:30 AM to 10:00 AM.

Boarding and departure from Playa d’en Bossa: 10:30 AM.

Disembarkation in Formentera: 12:00 PM, at La Savina port.

Boarding and departure from Formentera: 6:00 PM (5:00 PM from September).

Arrival in Ibiza: 9:00 PM (20:00 PM - 20:30 PM from September).




Itinerary


Visualize your route














9:30 AM – 10:00 AM · Check-in at Sea Experience Ibiza

Check-in takes place at the Sea Experience Ibiza stand, located at the departure point in Playa d’en Bossa.














10:30 AM · Boarding and departure from Playa d’en Bossa

Board the boat and begin the crossing to Formentera.














10:30 AM – 12:00 PM · Breakfast on board and swimming stop

Enjoy breakfast during the trip and a swimming stop before arriving in Formentera.














12:00 PM · Disembarkation at La Savina, Formentera

Arrive at La Savina port and begin your free time on the island.














12:00 PM – 6:00 PM · Free time in Formentera

Explore Formentera at your own pace, visit its beaches, discover the island or relax before returning to the boat.














6:00 PM (5:00 PM from September) · Boarding and departure from Formentera

events.name: San Antonio to Es Vedrà Boat Trip - Sunset
events.description:
Visit one of the most beautiful and magical natural environments on the coast of Ibiza. During this 4-hour Cruise you will be able to discover numerous coves of Ibiza.


The excursion begins with a scenic journey towards Es Vedrà, the island’s largest and most iconic natural reserve. Along the way, you’ll enjoy breathtaking views of some of Ibiza’s most beautiful coves, including Port des Torrent, Cala Bassa, Cala Conta, Cala Tarida, Cala Molí, Cala Vadella, Cala Carbó and Cala d’Hort.



Once you reach Es Vedrà, the boat sails around this spectacular natural landmark while the crew explains its history and legends. Afterwards, depending on sea conditions, you head towards Cala Conta or Cala Bassa, where you can stop for a refreshing swim in crystal-clear waters before making your way back to the port of San Antonio.



The price includes drinks and Finger Food and enjoying one of the best sunsets in the world on your way back to port.




What's included?

- 4h Boat trip from San Antonio to Es Vedrà (4.30pm-8.30pm)


- Sunset


- Local guide on board


- Drinks (water, soft drinks, sangria, white wine and beer)


- Finger Food


- Swim stop at Cala Bassa or Cala Conta (dependig on sea conditions)


- Underwater vision




What to expect San Antonio to Es Vedrà Boat Trip Sunset

Visit one of the most beautiful natural environments in Ibiza. Departing from San Antonio, throughout the route you can admire the beaches of Cala Bassa, Cala Conta, Cala Molí, Cala Vadella, Cala Carbó and Cala D'Hort and the islands of Conejera, del Bosque, Ses Bledes, S'Espartà and Es Vedrà.




Important Information

- Departure from San Antonio port, Captain Nemo kiosk (See map)


- Departure times may vary depending on the time of year


- Recommended for all ages


- There will be a swim stop, so you must bring a swim suit and towel. Bring sun protection, sunglasses, sunscreen, a hat...




If you would like to enjoy this excursion but in the morning, you can book your place here: San Antonio to Es Vedrà Boat Trip Daytime

events.name: Natural Park Aquarium Boat Trip
events.description:
Natural Park Aquarium is a 3 hour boat trip departing from San Antonio from 11:00am to 2:00pm. A trip to the northwest of the island of Ibiza. The first stop is the Cap Blanc Aquarium, an old lobster nursery inside a cave that houses different species endemic to the Pityusic sea. During this route you will see different coves such as Cala Gració, Cala Gracioneta, Cala Salada, Cala Saladeta and Punta Galera. Finally you reach the Margaritas Islands, a nature reserve off the coast of Ses Balandres. It is here that we make a swim stop of approximately 45 minutes where you can use the different aquatic equipment. After the swim stop, you will enjoy a small snack of fruit and salty snacks.

· 3h Boat trip (11:00am - 2:00pm)

· Drinks (water, soft drinks, sangria, white wine and beer)

· Fruits and salty snacks


· Swim stop

· Visit to the Cap Blanc Aquarium

It also includes hotel pickup and drop-off, making it a very convenient option to explore Ibiza in a single day.

7–8 hour guided bus tour around the island of Ibiza.

Traditional Ibizan village · San José or Santa Gertrudis

Portinatx / San Miguel / Cala San Vicente · free time

Hippie market · Punta Arabí / Las Dalias

Return to hotels

The experience includes the ferry transfer from Ibiza, with departures from Santa Eulalia, Es Canar or Cala Llonga, followed by a 3-hour boat tour with guide, lunch on board, drinks, a swim stop and water activities. After the excursion, enjoy free time in Formentera before returning to Ibiza at 5:00 PM or 6:00 PM.

What’s included?


Transfer to Formentera with the first ferry from Es Canar, Santa Eulalia or Cala Llonga.

3-hour boat tour around Formentera’s west coast, from 11:00 AM to 2:00 PM.

Guide on board with live commentary in Spanish, English and German.

Drinks included: water, soft drinks, beer and sangria.

Finger food buffet lunch with options for everyone, including vegan, gluten-free and allergy-friendly alternatives with advance notice.

Fresh seasonal fruit served freshly cut on board.

Water activities: swim stop, snorkel equipment, paddle surf and floating mats.

Chill-out music on board.

Free time in Formentera after the excursion.

About the Into the Island Combo Tour


There is no better way to discover Ibiza than by land and sea.
This full-day Into the Island experience combines a boat trip, a 4x4 safari, a hike and a magical sunset picnic in front of Es Vedrà.



The adventure starts aboard a powerful semi-rigid boat from San Antonio harbour, sailing through crystal-clear waters, passing the famous “Heaven’s Door” and stopping at hidden spots for swimming and snorkelling.



After the boat trip, continue the journey in a safari-style Land Rover Defender 4x4, exploring secret viewpoints and off-road tracks across the southwest of Ibiza before ending the day with a 1-hour hike and sunset picnic facing the iconic rock of Es Vedrà.





All the information about the Combo Tour

What’s included?


Boat trip with swimming and snorkelling stops.

4x4 safari in a Land Rover Defender.

1-hour hike with secret Es Vedrà viewpoints.

Sunset picnic with homemade sangria.

2 guides who speak Spanish, French and English.

Boat with skipper.

4x4 with driver.

Water, soft drinks and beer onboard.

Snorkelling equipment.

HQ photos and videos.

Insurance included.




Pick-up & drop-off

Drop-off: Ibiza Town.




Prices

Boat trip · Heaven’s Door & hidden spots

Sail from San Antonio harbour, pass Heaven’s Door and stop at secret places for swimming, snorkelling and drinks aboard.














4x4 Safari · Southwest Ibiza

Explore inaccessible off-road tracks and spectacular viewpoints in a safari-style Land Rover Defender.














1-hour hike · Es Vedrà viewpoints

Walk along rocky paths to discover the most beautiful and secret viewpoints facing Es Vedrà.














Sunset picnic in front of Es Vedrà

End the day with a magical sunset picnic and homemade sangria prepared by a catering service.









Important information


Duration: 7–8 hours.

Pick-up: around 2:30 PM depending on sunset time.

Transfer included from: Ibiza Town and San Antonio harbour.

Drop-off: Ibiza Town.

Languages: Spanish, French and English guides.

and no licence is required, so it’s suitable for all levels.



Cala Salada tour

Located just a few minutes by jet ski from the port of San Antonio, it’s the perfect way to explore the coastline and escape the crowds.




Cala Conta tour

The beach with some of the clearest waters in Ibiza. It’s an excellent spot for a paradisiacal swim in transparent waters.

About the Chilli Pepper Boat trip


Experience the Chilli Pepper, a boat trip on a classic llaüt around the bay of San Antonio and the most beautiful beaches on the west coast of Ibiza.




Along the way, there is time to swim in crystal-clear water, relax on deck and simply enjoy the peaceful feeling of being surrounded by the sea.




For around three hours, we cruise through the stunning Bay of San Antonio, discovering hidden coves, turquoise waters and dramatic cliffs that define Ibiza’s west coast.




Discover the best hidden spots in Ibiza with a chill out style décor, music and a great atmosphere.






All the information about Chilli Pepper Boat

What's included?


Boat trip on a llaüt departing from San Antonio.

Drinks included: sangria, beer, soft drinks and water.

Spanish tapas and fresh fruit served on board.

Water activities and time to swim in crystal-clear waters.

Secret caves and hidden coastal spots along the route.

Music on board with a relaxed chill out atmosphere.




Departure point



Departure from the Port of Sant Antoni de Portmany.




Check-in


Check-in: 30 minutes before each departure.


Address: Carrer del Far 6, San Antonio de Portmany 07820.
See map




Itinerary


Visualize your route














Departure from San Antonio

Board the traditional Ibizan llaüt at the port of San Antonio and begin your relaxed cruise along Ibiza’s west coast.














Cruise through San Antonio Bay

Enjoy the calm bay, music on board and views of the coastline before heading towards Ibiza’s west coast beaches.














Cala Bassa, Cala Conta & secret caves

The usual route visits Cala Bassa, Cala Conta and secret caves, with turquoise waters and beautiful coastal scenery.














Alternative route to Cala Salada

If wind or sea conditions are unfavourable, the captain may change the route towards Cala Salada and nearby sheltered coves.














Swimming stop, tapas & drinks

Stop to swim, relax on deck and enjoy Spanish tapas, fresh fruit and drinks included during the trip.














Return to San Antonio

Head back to port after around three hours at sea, having enjoyed one of Ibiza’s most relaxed boat experiences.









Important information


Check-in: 30 minutes before each departure.

Departures: 10:00 / 14:00 / 18:00.

Duration: around 3 hours.

Route: normally Cala Bassa, Cala Conta and secret caves.

Weather policy: the route may change to Cala Salada if wind or sea conditions are unfavourable.
